movies.title: The Package
movies.tagline: Friendship is just the tip.

movies.overview: Left heartbroken after Romeo begins to pursue her cousin Juliet, Rosaline schemes to foil the famous romance and win back her guy in this comedic twist of Shakespeare's Romeo and Juliet.
movies.title: Rosaline
movies.tagline: The love story you know, the ex you don’t.

movies.overview: The plot is unknown at this time.
movies.title: Clue

movies.original_title: Vivre sa vie: film en douze tableaux
movies.overview: Twelve episodic tales in the life of a Parisian woman and her slow descent into prostitution.
movies.title: Vivre Sa Vie
movies.tagline: The many faces of a woman trying to find herself.

movies.overview: In 1959, an alien experiment crashes to earth and infects a fraternity member. They freeze the body, but in the modern day, two geeks pledging a fraternity accidentally thaw the corpse, which proceeds to infect the campus with parasites that transform their hosts into killer zombies.
movies.title: Night of the Creeps
movies.tagline: The good news is your date is here. The bad news is...He's dead.

movies.overview: Cash is trying to live a quiet, honest life in a small Appalachian town. When a vicious crime boss forces him back into her services, he soon learns he's capable of anything -- even killing -- to protect his family and his home.
movies.title: Red Right Hand
movies.tagline: God. Family. Survival.

movies.overview: A corrupt cop gets in over his head when he tries to assassinate a beautiful Russian hit-woman.
movies.title: Romeo Is Bleeding
movies.tagline: The story of a cop who wanted it bad and got it worse.

movies.overview: After years of maneuvering the canal-ridden, superstitious city, a black cat named Nero begins to question whether he’s lived the right lives. Indebted to a local feline mob boss, Nero finds himself in a quandary and is forced to forge a truly unexpected friendship that may finally lead him to his purpose—unless Venice gets the better of him first.
movies.title: Gatto

movies.overview: Nellikampoil, a village adjacent to Forest, is very common. Many strange events are taking place in this land full of many myths. A figure with the legs of a horse and the body of a man is filling the land with fear by hanging a chicken head in the houses and hiding it in darkness and fear.
movies.title: Nellikkampoyil Night Riders

movies.overview: Architect Jesse Hughes uproots his wife and their two kids to an old house in the countryside, in the middle of nowhere, to try to piece back together an almost broken marriage. But Keith later finds that sometimes a change is not always the best solution when they get some unexpected visitors in their new home.
movies.title: Leave

movies.overview: an Australian independent drama directed by Duncan James, following a bored, suburban housewife named Suze who discovers shocking secrets about her husband during a solo road trip. The 1h 23m film explores themes of guilt, redemption, and complex family dynamics with a French-cinema-inspired style.
movies.title: Misgivings
movies.tagline: a journey of self-discovery

movies.overview: An arrogant reporter exploits a story about a man trapped in a cave to revitalize his career.
movies.title: Ace in the Hole
movies.tagline: Rough, tough Chuck Tatum, who battered his way to the top... trampling everything in his path - men, women and morals !

movies.overview: A police officer and a psychologist investigate the deaths of five people who were killed while trying to summon ghosts.
movies.title: Demonic
movies.tagline: Every House Has Its Secrets

movies.overview: Set after the attack on Pearl Harbor, four of America’s top college football stars set their fame aside to enlist in the Marines. As they prepare for the brutal invasion of Okinawa, they play in a legendary game featuring some of the greatest players in history – a game that, for many, will be the last they ever play
movies.title: The Mosquito Bowl

movies.overview: On August 7th 1974, French tightrope walker Philippe Petit stepped out on a high wire, illegally rigged between New York's World Trade Center twin towers, then the world's tallest buildings. After nearly an hour of performing on the wire, 1,350 feet above the sidewalks of Manhattan, he was arrested. This fun and spellbinding documentary chronicles Philippe Petit's "highest" achievement.
movies.title: Man on Wire
movies.tagline: 1974. 1350 feet up. The artistic crime of the century.

movies.overview: A luxury condo manager leads a staff of workers to seek payback on the Wall Street swindler who defrauded them. With only days until the billionaire gets away with the perfect crime, the unlikely crew of amateur thieves enlists the help of petty crook Slide to steal the $20 million they’re sure is hidden in the penthouse.
movies.title: Tower Heist
movies.tagline: It's not just a robbery. It's payback.

movies.overview: Living a torturous life of poverty and barely able to survive, Hwa-yeon decides to offer herself as one of the king’s concubines. Once inside the royal palace, two men are immediately seized by the woman - the Grand Prince Seong-won, a megalomaniacal ruler drunk with power and lust, and Kwon-yoo, who has everything to lose if his desire for Hwa-yeon is exposed.
movies.title: The Concubine
movies.tagline: The one the king couldn't have.

movies.overview: In 1980s Beirut, Mason Skiles is a former U.S. diplomat who is called back into service to save a colleague from the group that is possibly responsible for his own family's death. Meanwhile, a CIA field agent who is working under cover at the American embassy is tasked with keeping Mason alive and ensuring that the mission is a success.
movies.title: Beirut
movies.tagline: Beirut, 1982: The Paris of the Middle East Was Burning

movies.original_title: Hell House LLC Origins: The Carmichael Manor
movies.overview: A group of cold case investigators stay at the Carmichael Manor, site of the grisly and unsolved murders of the Carmichael family back in the eighties. After four nights, the group was never heard from again. What is discovered on their footage is even more disturbing than anything found on the Hell House tapes.
movies.title: Hell House LLC Origins: The Carmichael Manor
movies.tagline: Every story has an origin.

movies.original_title: Un condamné à mort s'est échappé
movies.overview: A captured French Resistance fighter during World War II engineers a daunting escape from prison.
movies.title: A Man Escaped
movies.tagline: Robert Bresson's Prize Winning Film

movies.overview: Unable to process the death of his daughter, Detective Boyd embarks on a hunt for a serial killer who murders according to a brutal tribal ritual: Muti. The only person who can help Boyd is Professor Mackles, an anthropologist who hides an unspeakable secret. The line between sanity and madness thins as Boyd goes deeper into the killer’s world.
movies.title: The Ritual Killer

movies.overview: A young man raised by scientists on Mars returns to Earth to find his father.
movies.title: The Space Between Us
movies.tagline: What's your favorite thing about Earth?

movies.overview: What begins as a casual fling between a married man, Ram a.k.a Satya and Manasa in the middle of an international business trip, balloons into an out-of-the-blue mess when the latter lands in Hyderabad, disrupting Ram’s otherwise stable marriage with Balamani.
movies.title: Bhartha Mahasayulaku Wignyapthi

movies.overview: A young and talented architect comes to his senses after a horrific accident only to find himself in the odd dystopian world. A world that is filled with the memories of all current coma patients. Just like a human memory this world is fragmental, chaotic and unstable. This is COMA: icecaps, rivers and cities can all exist in a space of a single room and laws of physics are no longer laws as they can be bent.
movies.title: Coma
movies.tagline: Wake up to save everyone

movies.overview: Tess enlists her biological father – a lovable slacker from the wrong side of the tracks – and the charming juvenile delinquent next door to help her come to grips with the death of her little sister.
movies.title: Dear Zoe

movies.overview: A seemingly bright and mostly innocent 16-year-old named Mo attempts to navigate high school under the guidance of his best friend Zeke, an unmotivated-yet-charismatic college dropout. Although Zeke genuinely cares about Mo, things start to go awry as he teaches Mo nontraditional life lessons in drug dealing, partying, and dating. Meanwhile, Mo’s well-meaning dad tries to step in and take back the reins of his son’s upbringing.
movies.title: Big Time Adolescence
movies.tagline: Under his influence.

movies.overview: David Attenborough takes viewers on a breathtaking journey showing there is nowhere more vital for our survival, more full of life, wonder, or surprise, than the ocean. Through spectacular sequences featuring coral reefs, kelp forests and the open ocean, Attenborough shares why a healthy ocean keeps the entire planet stable and flourishing.
movies.title: Ocean with David Attenborough

movies.original_title: The Goods: Live Hard, Sell Hard
movies.overview: Don Ready is many things, but he is best-known as an extraordinary salesman. When a car dealership in Temecula teeters on the brink of bankruptcy, he and his ragtag team dive in to save the day. But what Ready doesn't count on is falling in love and finding his soul.
movies.title: The Goods: Live Hard, Sell Hard

movies.overview: In 1879 Paris, a young orphan dreams of becoming a ballerina and flees her rural Brittany for Paris, where she passes for someone else and accedes to the position of pupil at the Grand Opera house.
movies.title: Ballerina
movies.tagline: Life's greatest adventures begin with a single leap.

movies.overview: Carrie, Charlotte, and Miranda are all married now, but they're still up for a little fun in the sun. When Samantha gets the chance to visit one of the most extravagant vacation destinations on the planet and offers to bring them all along, they surmise that a women-only retreat may be the perfect excuse to eschew their responsibilities and remember what life was like before they decided to settle down.
movies.title: Sex and the City 2
movies.tagline: Carrie on.

movies.overview: After flying home to L.A. for the funeral of his estranged record-producer father, a struggling man discovers that the will stipulates that he must deliver $150,000 in cash to a 30-year-old alcoholic sister he never knew existed, and her troubled 12-year-old son.
movies.title: People Like Us
movies.tagline: Find your family.

movies.overview: Stéphanie, a police officer working for Internal Affairs, is assigned to a case involving a young man severely wounded during a tense and chaotic demonstration in Paris. While she finds no evidence of illegitimate police violence, the case takes a personal turn when she discovers the victim is from her hometown.
movies.title: Case 137

movies.overview: Posing as a wealthy, jet-setting diamond mogul, an Israeli conman wooed women online then conned them out of millions of dollars. Now, some victims plan for payback.
movies.title: The Tinder Swindler
movies.tagline: Modern love is a dangerous game.

movies.overview: 9th century China. Ten year old general’s daughter Nie Yinniang is abducted by a nun who initiates her into the martial arts, transforming her into an exceptional assassin charged with eliminating cruel and corrupt local governors. One day, having failed in a task, she is sent back by her mistress to the land of her birth, with orders to kill the man to whom she was promised – a cousin who now leads the largest military region in North China. After 13 years of exile, the young woman must confront her parents, her memories and her long-repressed feelings.
movies.title: The Assassin

movies.overview: I'm Still Here is a portrayal of a tumultuous year in the life of actor Joaquin Phoenix. With remarkable access, the film follows the Oscar-nominee as he announces his retirement from a successful film career in the fall of 2008 and sets off to reinvent himself as a hip-hop musician. The film is a portrait of an artist at a crossroads and explores notions of courage and creative reinvention, as well as the ramifications of a life spent in the public eye.
movies.title: I'm Still Here
movies.tagline: He's done with Hollywood.

movies.overview: In 1953, an innocent man named Christopher Emmanuel "Manny" Balestrero is arrested after being mistaken for an armed robber.
movies.title: The Wrong Man
movies.tagline: HITCHCOCK'S FIRST REAL-LIFE THRILLER!

movies.overview: A dangerous combination of radiation and insecticide causes the unfortunate Scott Carey to shrink, slowly but surely, until he is only a few inches tall. His home becomes a wilderness where he must survive everything from spiders living in the cellar to his beloved cat.
movies.title: The Incredible Shrinking Man
movies.tagline: A fascinating adventure into the unknown!

movies.overview: Captain Jean-Luc Picard and the crew of the Enterprise-D find themselves at odds with the renegade scientist Soran who is destroying entire star systems. Only one man can help Picard stop Soran's scheme...and he's been dead for seventy-eight years.
movies.title: Star Trek: Generations
movies.tagline: Two captains. One destiny.

belongs_to_collection.name: Star Trek: The Next Generation Collection

movies.overview: The journey of a beautiful Indian Princess, who sets sail in the search of her husband. On her voyage, she undergoes transformations in her body, mind and soul with a fellow passenger who takes her to a forbidden world of sexual love and sensuality.
movies.title: Kamasutra 3D

movies.overview: Inside of his book, adventurous Harold can make anything come to life simply by drawing it. After he grows up and draws himself off the book's pages and into the physical world, Harold finds he has a lot to learn about real life.
movies.title: Harold and the Purple Crayon
movies.tagline: Everything he draws is about to get real.

movies.overview: In 1976, a lower-middle-class teenager struggles to cope living with her neurotic family of nomads on the outskirts of Beverly Hills.
movies.title: Slums of Beverly Hills
movies.tagline: Growing up is hard to do.

movies.overview: A love letter from a young mother to her daughter, the film tells the story of Waad al-Kateab’s life through five years of the uprising in Aleppo, Syria as she falls in love, gets married and gives birth to Sama, all while cataclysmic conflict rises around her.  Her camera captures incredible stories of loss, laughter and survival as Waad wrestles with an impossible choice– whether or not to flee the city to protect her daughter’s life, when leaving means abandoning the struggle for freedom for which she has already sacrificed so much.
movies.title: For Sama
movies.tagline: An intimate and epic journey into the female experience of war.

movies.overview: Rachel is a quick-witted and lovable stay-at-home mom, frustrated with the responsibilities of her son's preschool, a lacklustre sex life and a career that's gone kaput. One night, intent on spicing up their marriage, she visits an LA strip club with her husband, where she meets McKenna, a stripper she adopts as her live-in nanny.
movies.title: Afternoon Delight
movies.tagline: The cure for the common marriage

movies.overview: A lonely boy discovers a mysterious egg that hatches a sea creature of Scottish legend.
movies.title: The Water Horse
movies.tagline: How do you keep a secret this big?

movies.overview: Rohan's affluent lifestyle spirals out of control as he becomes convinced there is a supernatural entity in his home. As he starts to uncover the mystery, he is drawn into unexpected worlds and alliances, along with the horrors that lie ahead.
movies.title: Diés Iraé
movies.tagline: The Day of Wrath

movies.overview: Titus Andronicus returns from the wars and sees his sons and daughters taken from him, one by one. Shakespeare's goriest and earliest tragedy.
movies.title: Titus
movies.tagline: The fate of an empire. The descent of man.

movies.overview: High school janitor Rickey loses everything when his girlfriend, Kelly, is selected to play hockey for Team USA and compete in the World Games. To win her back, Rickey creates a misfit curling team and uses his sweeping skills to compete for gold and complete a comic quest for redemption that captivates the nation.
movies.title: The Roaring Game
movies.tagline: Grab life by the stones.

movies.overview: In Manhattan, a bike messenger picks up an envelope that attracts the interest of a dirty cop, who pursues the cyclist throughout the city.
movies.title: Premium Rush
movies.tagline: Ride Like Hell

movies.overview: In a world where superpowered people are heavily policed by robots, an ex-con teams up with a drug lord he despises to protect a teen from a corrupt cop.
movies.title: Code 8 Part II
movies.tagline: Power corrupts.

movies.overview: Kyle and Mike are best friends who share a close bond — until Mike sleeps with Kyle’s fiancée. A stormy but enduring relationship ensues between Kyle, with limitless patience, and Mike, who only lives his life by sowing discord in that of others, across many years of laughter, heartbreak, and rage.
movies.title: The Climb

movies.overview: After his family is evicted from their home, proud and desperate construction worker Dennis Nash tries to win his home back by striking a deal with the devil and working for Rick Carver, the corrupt real estate broker who evicted him.
movies.title: 99 Homes
movies.tagline: Greed is the only game in town.

movies.overview: In the wake of a nuclear war, a young woman survives on her own, fearing she may actually be the proverbial last woman on earth, until she discovers the most astonishing sight of her life: another human being. A distraught scientist, he’s nearly been driven mad by radiation exposure and his desperate search for others. A fragile, imperative strand of trust connects them. But when a stranger enters the valley, their precarious bond begins to unravel.
movies.title: Z for Zachariah
movies.tagline: After the end of the world she thought she was alone. She was wrong.

movies.overview: Rookie cop Alicia West, an Army veteran, inadvertently captures the murder of a young drug dealer on her body cam. After realizing that the murder was committed by corrupt cops, she teams up with the one person from her community who is willing to help her as she tries to escape both the criminals out for revenge and the police who are desperate to destroy the incriminating footage.
movies.title: Black and Blue
movies.tagline: Survive the night. Expose the truth.

movies.overview: A poor young man is wrongly charged with drug trafficking after being deceived. An ex-prosecutor investigates the case, uncovers a corrupt lawyer team's scheme, and restores justice despite obstruction from evil forces.
movies.title: The Prosecutor
movies.tagline: Fight for justice.

movies.overview: A woman lawyer becomes mesmerized by a self-made millionaire during an encounter in Rio setting off a series of erotic encounters.
movies.title: Wild Orchid
movies.tagline: An adventure of the senses.

movies.overview: A young girl, with an amazing ability to communicate with insects, is transferred to an exclusive Swiss boarding school, where her unusual capability might help solve a string of murders.
movies.title: Phenomena
movies.tagline: Jennifer has a few million close friends. She's going to need them all!

movies.overview: A young social climber wins the heart of a beautiful heiress but his former girlfriend's pregnancy stands in the way of his ambition.
movies.title: A Place in the Sun
movies.tagline: Young people asking so much of life... taking so much of love!

movies.overview: 16-year old Rhiannon falls in love with a mysterious spirit named “A” that inhabits a different body every day. Feeling an unmatched connection, Rhiannon and “A” work each day to find each other, not knowing what the next day will bring.
movies.title: Every Day
movies.tagline: Every day a different body. Every day a different life. Every day in love with the same girl.

movies.overview: On the day before Christmas Eve, investment banker Zara begrudgingly finds herself mingling with a group of strangers at an open house. When a reluctant bank robber inadvertently takes the group hostage, chaos and oversharing ensues, secrets are revealed and literally nothing goes according to plan
movies.title: Anxious People

movies.overview: When an army commando finds out his true love is engaged against her will, he boards a New Dehli-bound train in a daring quest to derail the arranged marriage. But when a gang of knife-wielding thieves begin to terrorize innocent passengers on his train, the commando takes them on, one by one.
movies.title: Kill
movies.tagline: The end of the line starts here.

movies.overview: Based on the real-life experiences of Ed Horman. A conservative American businessman travels to Chile to investigate the sudden disappearance of his son after a military takeover. Accompanied by his son's wife he uncovers a trail of cover-ups that implicate the US State department which supports the dictatorship.
movies.title: Missing
movies.tagline: Ed Horman thought that being an American would guarantee his safety. His family believed that being Americans would guarantee them the truth. They were all wrong.

movies.overview: In 2006, a group of thieves performed what is considered one of the most famous and smart bank heists in the history of Argentina. How they robbed the Rio bank is as surprising as what happened afterwards. This is their story.
movies.title: The Heist of the Century
movies.tagline: The Story Of The Theft That Made History

movies.overview: Far away from the site of a gruesome murder, a teenager named Jill Johnson arrives at a luxurious home for a baby-sitting job. With the children fast asleep, she settles in for what she expects to be an ordinary evening. Soon, the ringing of a phone and the frightening words of a sadistic caller turn Jill's routine experience into a night of terror.
movies.title: When a Stranger Calls
movies.tagline: Whatever You Do, Don't Answer The Phone.

movies.overview: While incarcerated for murder, cartoonist Jack Deebs found escape by creating Cool World, a series featuring a voluptuous femme fatale named Holli Would. But the artist becomes a prisoner of his own fantasies when Holli transports Jack into Cool World with a scheme to seduce him and bring herself to life. Hard-boiled detective Frank Harris – the only other human in Cool World – cautions Jack with the law: Noids (humans) don't have sex with doodles (cartoons). However, flesh proves weaker than ink as Holli takes human form in Las Vegas, staring in a trans-universal chase that threatens the destruction of both worlds.
movies.title: Cool World
movies.tagline: Holli Would if she could ...and she will

movies.overview: A romantic drifter gets caught between a corrupt tycoon and his voluptuous wife.
movies.title: The Lady from Shanghai
movies.tagline: I told you... you know nothing about wickedness

movies.overview: Syd March is an employee at a clinic that sells injections of live viruses harvested from sick celebrities to obsessed fans. When he becomes infected with the disease that kills super sensation Hannah Geist, Syd becomes a target for collectors and rabid fans. He must unravel the mystery surrounding her death before he suffers the same fate.
movies.title: Antiviral
movies.tagline: What If You Could Feel Like They Do... We Can Help.

movies.overview: As Pushpa, a labourer, rises in the world of red sandalwood smuggling, he ends up making many enemies. However, violence ensues when the police try to topple his illegal business.
movies.title: Pushpa: The Rise

movies.overview: Four kayakers take the wrong river into a jungle inhabited by a tribe of merciless cannibals.
movies.title: River of Blood

movies.overview: Home from boarding school after years abroad, a precocious teenager, Mimmina, becomes obsessed with seducing her journalist father.
movies.title: Mimi

movies.overview: One-armed war veteran John J. Macreedy steps off a train at the sleepy little town of Black Rock.  Once there, he begins to unravel a web of lies, secrecy, and murder.
movies.title: Bad Day at Black Rock
movies.tagline: Just the way it happened!

movies.overview: A bored, retired rock star sets out to find his father's tormentor, an ex-Nazi war criminal who is a refugee in the U.S.
movies.title: This Must Be the Place
movies.tagline: A former rockstar is hunting down a Nazi criminal. This could be his greatest hit.

movies.overview: Jay and Silent Bob embark on a cross-country mission to stop Hollywood from rebooting a film based on their comic book characters Bluntman and Chronic.
movies.title: Jay and Silent Bob Reboot
movies.tagline: Weed love to tell you a story...

movies.overview: When a sudden plague of blindness devastates a city, a small group of the afflicted band together to triumphantly overcome the horrific conditions of their imposed quarantine.
movies.title: Blindness
movies.tagline: Your vision of the world will change forever.

movies.overview: As their first year of high school looms ahead, best friends Julie, Hannah, Yancy and Farrah have one last summer sleepover. Little do they know they're about to embark on the adventure of a lifetime. Desperate to shed their nerdy status, they take part in a night-long scavenger hunt that pits them against their popular archrivals. Everything under the sun goes on -- from taking Yancy's father's car to sneaking into nightclubs!
movies.title: Sleepover
movies.tagline: The rules are set. The game is on.

movies.overview: France, 1963. Anne is a bright young student with a promising future ahead of her. But when she falls pregnant, she sees the opportunity to finish her studies and escape the constraints of her social background disappearing. With her final exams fast approaching and her belly growing, Anne resolves to act, even if she has to confront shame and pain, even if she must risk prison to do so.
movies.title: Happening

movies.overview: When architect-turned-recluse Bernadette Fox goes missing prior to a family trip to Antarctica, her 15-year-old daughter, Bee, goes on a quest with Bernadette's husband to find her.
movies.title: Where'd You Go, Bernadette
movies.tagline: Disappearances can be deceiving

movies.overview: Forced to face the cruel side of life, a devastated, bankrupt merchant chances upon the enchanted castle of a hideous creature, the mere sight of it chills the bone to the marrow. There, a fate worse than death awaits the poor father-of-six, who, after plucking a sweet-scented rose from the repulsive master's verdant garden, must do the impossible: permit his compassionate daughter, Belle, to take his place and pay for the sins of her parent. Now, an impenetrable mystery shrouds the haunted mansion, and, as repugnance gradually turns into affection, only true love could break the spell.
movies.title: Beauty and the Beast
movies.tagline: The legend is reborn...

movies.overview: A spirited heiress wishing to break into theatre on her own merit arrives at a boardinghouse where aspiring young actresses and showgirls are brought together through their cynicism and disappointments.
movies.title: Stage Door
movies.tagline: Great stars! Great story! Great picture!

movies.overview: New York gangster Ben 'Bugsy' Siegel takes a brief business trip to Los Angeles. A sharp-dressing womanizer with a foul temper, Siegel doesn't hesitate to kill or maim anyone crossing him. In L.A. the life, the movies, and most of all strong-willed Virginia Hill detain him while his family wait back home. Then a trip to a run-down gambling joint at a spot in the desert known as Las Vegas gives him his big idea.
movies.title: Bugsy
movies.tagline: Glamour was the disguise.

movies.overview: The U.S. President, low in the opinion polls, gets talked into raising his popularity by trying to start a cold war with Canada.
movies.title: Canadian Bacon
movies.tagline: It's lonely at the top when there's no butt left to kick.

movies.overview: On the most important day of his young life, a high school senior is forced to relive his failed attempt at losing his virginity over and over again, until he gets it right.
movies.title: Premature

movies.overview: After thirty years of marriage, a middle-aged couple attends an intense, week-long counseling session to work on their relationship.
movies.title: Hope Springs
movies.tagline: Sometimes to keep the magic, you need to learn a few tricks.

movies.original_title: Sunrise: A Song of Two Humans
movies.overview: A married farmer falls under the spell of a slatternly woman from the city, who tries to convince him to drown his wife.
movies.title: Sunrise: A Song of Two Humans
movies.tagline: "An artistic masterpiece and also a joy to watch."

movies.overview: Two wannabe Black American princesses aim to marry rich men, who will pay for their world's first combination hair salon and soul food restaurant.
movies.title: B.A.P.S
movies.tagline: These Pretty Women... Are Clueless!

movies.overview: A heroic true story of Major Mukund Varadarajan, an Indian Army officer who displayed extraordinary bravery during a counterterrorism mission in Kashmir’s Shopian district. The film captures his courage in protecting his nation and the devotion of his wife Indhu Rebecaa Varghese.
movies.title: Amaran

movies.overview: A Yorkshire coal mine is threatened with closure and the only hope is for the men to enter their Grimley Colliery Brass Band into a national competition. They believe they have no hope until Gloria appears carrying her Flugelhorn. At first mocked for being a woman, she soon becomes the only chance for the band to win.
movies.title: Brassed Off
movies.tagline: Fed up with the system. Ticked off at the establishment. And mad about... each other.

movies.overview: A newlywed couple checks into a mysterious house in Himachal Pradesh. When the wife disappears, the husband is suspected. As the investigation unfolds, the house unveils shocking secrets.
movies.title: The Rabbit House

movies.overview: A love potion works its devious charms on fairies, elves and the swamp-dwelling Bog King as they all try to possess the potion for themselves.
movies.title: Strange Magic
movies.tagline: Everyone deserves to be loved.

movies.overview: A U.S. Marine Corps colonel alerts the president of a planned military coup against him.
movies.title: Seven Days in May
movies.tagline: The astounding story of an astounding military plot to take over the United States! The time is 1970 or 1980 or, possibly, tomorrow!

movies.overview: Enforcing the law within the notoriously rough Brownsville section of the city and especially within the Van Dyke housing projects is the NYPD's sixty-fifth precinct. Three police officers struggle with the sometimes fine line between right and wrong.
movies.title: Brooklyn's Finest
movies.tagline: This is War. This is Brooklyn.

movies.overview: Love-struck Jaggi can cross the seven seas for his dream girl, Kartika. Even if it means stopping her wedding as he doesn't want to be friend-zoned.
movies.title: Shiddat
movies.tagline: Feel the power of love

movies.overview: A loving father finds a clown suit for his son's birthday party, only to realize the suit is part of an evil curse that turns its wearer into a killer.
movies.title: Clown
movies.tagline: The kids aren't alright.

movies.overview: Tim Avery, an aspiring cartoonist, finds himself in a predicament when his dog stumbles upon the mask of Loki. Then after conceiving an infant son "born of the mask", he discovers just how looney child raising can be.
movies.title: Son of the Mask
movies.tagline: Who's next?

movies.overview: A group of World War II American soldiers encounter a supernatural enemy as they occupy a French castle previously under Nazi control.
movies.title: Ghosts of War
movies.tagline: You can't hide from yourself.

movies.overview: Two brilliant research scientists have invented a device capable of recording and playing back sensory experiences only to have devastating results when one of them records their own death.
movies.title: Brainstorm
movies.tagline: The door to the mind is open.

movies.original_title: A Nightmare on Elm Street Part 2: Freddy's Revenge
movies.overview: A teenage boy is haunted in his dreams by deceased child murderer Freddy Krueger, who is out to possess him in order to continue his reign of terror in the real world.
movies.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street Part 2: Freddy's Revenge
movies.tagline: The man of your dreams is back.

belongs_to_collection.name: A Nightmare on Elm Street Collection

movies.overview: A man and a woman are brought together by chance for several months. He is younger than she is, married, Russian, officially a diplomat stationed in Paris. She is a beautiful teacher and researcher, with her feet firmly on the ground. The film follows the evolution of their love, from the beginning to end.
movies.title: Simple Passion

movies.overview: A logger defends his family from a group of dangerous drug runners.
movies.title: Braven
movies.tagline: They threatened his world. He will destroy theirs.

movies.overview: The story centers on a group of gossipy, high-society women who spend their days at the beauty salon and haunting fashion shows. The sweet, happily-wedded Mary Haines finds her marriage in trouble when shop girl Crystal Allen gets her hooks into Mary's man.
movies.title: The Women

movies.overview: Three brothers find themselves sharing a home with the alluring new wife of the middle sibling. As they become infatuated with the same woman, a complex and enthralling tale ensues in this tropical paradise.
movies.title: River of Desire

movies.overview: After twelve years in prison, Walter returns home. His family has abandoned him, save for his brother-in-law. Few know he's a sex offender and pedophile. Walter finds an apartment and is regularly visited by his parole officer. He gets a job at a lumber mill and starts seeing a coworker. Then his new world begins to unravel; as his past becomes known, he strikes up a high-risk friendship with a young girl and realizes that a man loitering near a schoolyard is a child molester prowling for his next victim.
movies.title: The Woodsman
movies.tagline: Nothing can undo the past.

movies.overview: After their first adventure with the Hot Tub Time Machine, Lou and Nick are living very well off their ill-gotten gains, while Jacob still cannot rely on Lou to be a positive role model. When an unknown assailant breaks into Lou's mansion and shoots him, Nick and Jacob take him for another trip in the hot tub. They emerge in the year 2025, where they must figure out who shot Lou and prevent it from happening again.
movies.title: Hot Tub Time Machine 2
movies.tagline: The laws of space and time are about to be violated.

movies.overview: A group of Serbian socialists prepares for the war in a surreal underground filled by parties, tragedies, love and hate.
movies.title: Underground
movies.tagline: ONCE UPON A TIME THERE WAS A COUNTRY

movies.overview: Unemployed cartoonist Gord Brody moves back in with his parents Jim and Julie and younger brother Freddy. When his parents demand he leave, he retaliates by spreading rumors that Jim is sexually abusing Freddy.
movies.title: Freddy Got Fingered
movies.tagline: This time you can't change the channel.

movies.overview: Over the course of a day, a married couple, Mary and James Tyrone, and their two sons, Jamie and Edmund, grapple with Mary's morphine addiction and confront each other over the past in a series of emotionally tense and volatile exchanges.
movies.title: Long Day's Journey into Night

movies.overview: In a rural town in Louisiana, a black Master Sergeant is found shot to death just outside the local Army Base. Military lawyer, Captain Davenport—also a black man—is sent from Washington to conduct an investigation. Facing an uncooperative chain of command and fearful black troops, Davenport must battle with deceit and prejudice in order to find out exactly who really did kill the Master Sergeant.
movies.title: A Soldier's Story
movies.tagline: Alone, far from home, and far from justice, he has three days to learn the truth about a murder... and the truth is a story you won't forget.

movies.overview: A seminary student on monastery holiday kills an old witch in a remote village. The hag then transforms into a beautiful young woman whose dying wish is for him to watch over her wake for three nights. With terrors occurring and his faith waning, he reads prayers on the overnight watch and tries to survive the supernatural encounters.
movies.title: Viy
movies.tagline: The Soviet Union’s first horror film!

movies.overview: After hearing a loud ‘bang’ at daybreak, a Scottish woman begins experiencing a mysterious sensory syndrome while traversing the jungles of Colombia.
movies.title: Memoria
movies.tagline: In here, time stops.

movies.overview: Jake and Kristy Briggs are newlyweds. Being young, they are perhaps a bit unprepared for the full reality of marriage and all that it (and their parents) expect from them. Do they want babies? Their parents certainly want them to. Is married life all that there is? Things certainly aren't helped by Jake's friend Davis, who always seems to turn up just in time to put a spanner in the works.
movies.title: She's Having a Baby
movies.tagline: Man. Woman. Life. Death. Infinity. Tuna casserole. One movie dares to tell it all.

movies.overview: Sandra is a young woman who has only one weekend to convince her colleagues they must give up their bonuses in order for her to keep her job — not an easy task in this economy.
movies.title: Two Days, One Night
movies.tagline: A quest for self-improvement

movies.overview: Schoolteacher Bertram Cates is arrested for teaching his students Darwin's theory of evolution. The case receives national attention and one of the newspaper reporters, E.K. Hornbeck, arranges to bring in renowned defense attorney and atheist Henry Drummond to defend Cates. The prosecutor, Matthew Brady is a former presidential candidate, famous evangelist, and old adversary of Drummond.
movies.title: Inherit the Wind
movies.tagline: It’s all about the fabulous “Monkey Trial” that rocked America!

movies.overview: A successful Indian scientist returns home to his village to take his nanny back to America with him, and in the process rediscovers his roots.
movies.title: Swades
movies.tagline: We, the people.

movies.original_title: The Short History of the Long Road
movies.overview: Nola grew up living in a van with her father, Clint—two nomads against the world. When tragedy strikes, Nola must confront the reality of life on the road alone, learning to own her grief, her past, and her new destination.
movies.title: The Short History of the Long Road
movies.tagline: A story about survival.

movies.overview: A private military operation invents futuristic microchip tech that enables the mind of an agent to inhabit the body of another person to carry out covert, deadly missions. But when an agent is killed during a secret mission, his wife takes his place in an attempt to bring the man responsible to justice.
movies.title: Assassin
movies.tagline: Every body is a weapon.

movies.overview: When a band of brutal gangsters led by a crooked property developer make a play to take over the city, Master Ip is forced to take a stand.
movies.title: Ip Man 3
movies.tagline: The legend continues, the grandmaster returns.

movies.overview: Otis is a mischievous, carefree Holstein cow who lives on a farm where, unbeknownst to humans, the animals are anthropomorphic. He prefers having fun with his best friends: Pip the mouse, Freddy the ferret, Peck the rooster, and Pig the pig - rather than following strict rules and accepting responsibility. This annoys his stern adoptive father Ben, the leader of the farm's community. One evening, Otis convinces Ben to cover his night watch so he can attend a massive party in the barn and impress Daisy, a pregnant cow who recently arrived at the farm with her best friend Bessy as a newcomer. As the animals party, Dag the coyote and his pack attempt to raid the chicken coop. Ben fends them off alone but is fatally wounded and killed. Otis must now learn the value of responsibility when he becomes the leader of his farm home's community.
movies.title: Barnyard
movies.tagline: The secret lives of animals revealed!

movies.overview: A music-mad 16-year-old outcast at a rugby-mad boarding school forms an unlikely friendship with his dashing new roommate.
movies.title: Handsome Devil
movies.tagline: Follow the crowd, or follow your heart?

movies.overview: When a young rape victim takes justice into her own hands and becomes a serial killer, it's up to Dirty Harry Callahan, on suspension from the SFPD, to bring her to justice.
movies.title: Sudden Impact
movies.tagline: Dirty Harry is at it again

movies.overview: In a small English village everyone suddenly falls unconscious. When they awake every woman of child bearing age is pregnant. The resulting children have the same strange blond hair, eyes and a strong connection to each other.
movies.title: Village of the Damned
movies.tagline: What Demonic Force Lurks Behind Those Eyes?

movies.overview: For Norman and Ethel Thayer, this summer on golden pond is filled with conflict and resolution. When their daughter Chelsea arrives, the family is forced to renew the bonds of love and overcome the generational friction that has existed for years.
movies.title: On Golden Pond
movies.tagline: When life is at its finest... when love is at its fullest...

movies.overview: Haru and Luis love competing in Tokyo’s ballroom dance scene, but after tragedy strikes, Haru withdraws into isolation. When friends coax her back to the studio, she develops an infatuation with the new instructor. She must face what comes next as sparks fly.
movies.title: Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!

movies.overview: A young man fights to overcome violence plaguing his village and succeed as a professional kabaddi player.
movies.title: Bison Kaalamaadan

movies.overview: Headstrong farmer Rosemary Muldoon has her heart set on winning her neighbour Anthony Reilly's love. The problem is, Anthony seems to have inherited a family curse, and remains oblivious to his beautiful admirer. Stung by his father's plans to sell the family farm to his American nephew, Anthony is jolted into pursuing his dreams.
movies.title: Wild Mountain Thyme
movies.tagline: There's nothing more dangerous... than an Irish woman in love.

movies.overview: Led by their comedic and pranking leader, Newbomb Turk, the Hollywood Knights car gang raise hell throughout Beverly Hills on Halloween Night, 1965. Everything from drag racing to Vietnam to high school love.
movies.title: The Hollywood Knights
movies.tagline: Beverly Hills and the civilized world will never forget them.

movies.overview: A lazy, entitled brat who wants to lead an easy life is in for a rude shock that changes the course of his life.
movies.title: Anaganaga Oka Raju

movies.overview: A year after Sheila is killed in a hit-and-run, her multimillionaire husband invites a group of friends to spend a week on his yacht playing a scavenger hunt-style mystery game—but the game turns out to be all too real and all too deadly.
movies.title: The Last of Sheila
movies.tagline: Any number can play. Any number can die.

movies.overview: A young woman fights the spirit that is slowly taking possession of her.
movies.title: The Unborn
movies.tagline: Evil will do anything to live.

movies.overview: While waiting for her divorce papers, a repressed literature professor finds herself unexpectedly attracted by a carefree, spirited young woman named Cay.
movies.title: Desert Hearts
movies.tagline: In 1959, Vivian Bell came to Reno, Nevada for a quick divorce. Of all the people she met there, the one who surprised her the most was herself.

movies.overview: After a landsman in 18th century England discovers a corpse covered in fur buried in a field, the town becomes infected by "the devil's skin," leading the local children to engage in demonic rituals and criminal behavior.
movies.title: The Blood on Satan's Claw
movies.tagline: A chill-filled festival of horror!

movies.overview: A group of dated appliances, finding themselves stranded in a summer home that their family had just sold, decide to seek out their eight year old 'master'.
movies.title: The Brave Little Toaster
movies.tagline: Plug into the adventure!

movies.overview: A washed up golf pro working at a driving range tries to qualify for the US Open in order to win the heart of his succesful rival's girlfriend.
movies.title: Tin Cup
movies.tagline: Golf Pro. Love Amateur.

movies.overview: Civilisation is coming to an end. The death of his only relative gives a feral boy the pretext to journey beyond the confines of his home environment; only by doing this will he be able to decipher his father's journal, the most valuable artefact in his legacy. This singular contribution to the post-apocalyptic sci-fi genre tells of a humanity in crisis, while at the same time conveying the adventurous spirit of adolescence.
movies.title: Land of the Sons

movies.overview: After a Tibetan boy, the mystical Golden Child, is kidnapped by the evil Sardo Numspa, humankind's fate hangs in the balance. On the other side of the world in Los Angeles, the priestess Kee Nang seeks the Chosen One, who will save the boy from death. When Nang sees social worker Chandler Jarrell on television discussing his ability to find missing children, she solicits his expertise, despite his skepticism over being "chosen."
movies.title: The Golden Child
movies.tagline: Eddie Murphy is the chosen one.

movies.overview: Love blossoms for Lily over double Meaty Boy burgers at mid-day when uber-computer nerd Jarrod comes in and leaves with free extra large fries.  After gatecrashing Jarrod's party and proving her skills on the game console, Lily goes down to Jarrod's home town with him so he can settle an old score with a past school bully.
movies.title: Eagle vs Shark
movies.tagline: There's Someone For Everyone... Luckily Love Is Blind.

movies.overview: In 17th century France, young D'Artagnan wants to join the King's Musketeers, but instead befriends three legendary musketeers—Athos, Porthos, and Aramis—and together, they become embroiled in the political intrigue surrounding King Louis XIII and his adversaries, particularly the powerful Cardinal Richelieu.
movies.title: The Three Musketeers
movies.tagline: . . . One for All and All for Fun!

movies.overview: Neglected pensioner Elsie finds an unexpected ally in her younger neighbour Colleen. Over time, a friendship grows but Elsie’s resentful, guilt-ridden son stirs up tensions that bring shocking consequences.
movies.title: Dragonfly

movies.overview: In the not-too-distant future, an all-seeing surveillance state conducts “dream audits” to collect taxes on the unconscious lives of the populace. Mild-mannered government agent James Preble travels to a remote farmhouse to audit the dreams of Arabella “Bella” Isadora, an eccentric, aging artist. Entering Bella’s vast VHS archive, which contains a lifetime of dreams, Preble stumbles upon a secret that offers him a chance at love—and hope for escape.
movies.title: Strawberry Mansion
movies.tagline: Do you believe that your dreams are your own?

movies.overview: Zia, distraught over breaking up with his girlfriend, decides to end it all. Unfortunately, he discovers that there is no real ending, only a run-down afterlife that is strikingly similar to his old one, just a bit worse. Discovering that his ex-girlfriend has also "offed" herself, he sets out on a road trip to find her.
movies.title: Wristcutters: A Love Story
movies.tagline: Life is a trip, but the afterlife is one hell of a ride

movies.overview: Michael Jennings is a genius who's hired – and paid handsomely – by high-tech firms to work on highly sensitive projects, after which his short-term memory is erased so he's incapable of breaching security. But at the end of a three-year job, he's told he isn't getting a paycheck and instead receives a mysterious envelope. In it are clues he must piece together to find out why he wasn't paid – and why he's now in hot water.
movies.title: Paycheck
movies.tagline: The future depends on a past he was paid to forget.

movies.overview: When dignified Albert Donnelly runs for Governor, his team moves to keep his slow-witted and klutzy younger brother, Mike, out of the eye of the media. To baby-sit Mike, the campaign assigns sarcastic Steve, who gets the experience of a lifetime when he tries to take Mike out of town during the election.
movies.title: Black Sheep
movies.tagline: There's one in every family.

movies.overview: In the aftermath of her tumultuous relationship with a charismatic and manipulative older man, Julie begins to untangle her fraught love for him in making her graduation film, sorting fact from his elaborately constructed fiction.
movies.title: The Souvenir: Part II

movies.overview: When washed up stand-up comedian Mortimer Baldwin (Gareth Reynolds) is replaced on his popular podcast by a viral sensation 9-year-old, his manager (Jake Johnson) sends him out on a tour to reclaim his career and film his comeback comedy special - but what's so funny?
movies.title: Give It Up
movies.tagline: What's so funny?

movies.overview: Set over one day in Delhi, Bani, a writer, is racing against a career-defining 12-hour deadline. Mothers, aunts, cousins and former romantic interests descend on her apartment, each bringing their own emergencies and Bani has to navigate interfaith complexities, generational conflicts and family expectations as she faces a dilemma, which could alter her life trajectory forever.
movies.title: The Great Shamsuddin Family

movies.overview: Ten strangers are invited as weekend guests to a remote mountain mansion. When the host doesn't show up, the guests start dying, one by one.
movies.title: Ten Little Indians
movies.tagline: Ten people trapped in a house of death... And the murderer determined to kill them all— One By One By One!

movies.overview: Under therapeutic hypnosis, a seemingly well-adjusted young woman tells a fantastic story, verified by lie detector, of her forgotten marriage to a man who disappeared on the day of their honeymoon, and of her search for him which takes her to a lonely mansion in a remote section of swampland tenanted by snakes, alligators, a drunken one-armed lout, a mysterious doctor, and a cold-hearted elderly woman who lives alone in a brooding manse.
movies.title: The Alligator People
movies.tagline: Nerve-shattering terror!

movies.overview: It was a chance meeting started by one of Sol’s friends trying to chat up Jennifer. However, in the end, it was those two who hit it off. Sol enjoyed Jen’s smile, her effort, and how silly she could be. Jen enjoyed Sol’s cooking, his athleticism, and that he would join her in fun moments. As you can imagine, love bloomed, and things got serious. Jen’s investment in Sol led to her pushing him to follow his dreams and even move in to save money. Sol’s investment in Jen well, it led to him proposing. But what started as a liver tumor grew into full-on cancer, so with a diagnosis of 6 months to live, Sol and Jennifer try to make the best of it.
movies.title: All My Life
movies.tagline: Based on a true love story.

movies.overview: A man searches for his father, Pedro Páramo, in a town doomed by violence and the fury of a frustrated love.
movies.title: Pedro Páramo
movies.tagline: Nothing was heard but murmurs.

movies.overview: After his mother’s death, Zucchini is befriended by a kind police officer, Raymond, who accompanies him to his new foster home filled with other orphans his age. There, with the help of his newfound friends, Zucchini eventually learns to trust and love as he searches for a new family of his own.
movies.title: My Life as a Zucchini
movies.tagline: SOMETIMES WE CRY BECAUSE WE'RE HAPPY.

movies.overview: A hopeful, naive college freshman, Devon, asks the cool and confident Celeste to be her roommate, seeing a blossoming friendship spiral thereafter into a war of passive aggression.
movies.title: Roommates

movies.overview: A losing coach with an underdog football team faces their giants of fear and failure on and off the field to surprising results.
movies.title: Facing the Giants
movies.tagline: Never give up. Never back down. Never lose faith.

movies.overview: A singer goes to a small town for a performance before he is drafted.
movies.title: Bye Bye Birdie
movies.tagline: The Most WONDERFUL Entertainment EVER! EVER!

movies.overview: The illegitimate son of an African slave and a French plantation owner, Joseph Bologne rises to improbable heights in French society as a celebrated violinist-composer and fencer, complete with an ill-fated love affair and a falling out with Marie Antoinette and her court.
movies.title: Chevalier
movies.tagline: The true untold story.

movies.overview: An artist falls for a married young woman while he's commissioned to paint her portrait. The two invest in the risky tulip market in hopes to build a future together.
movies.title: Tulip Fever

movies.overview: Au revoir les enfants tells a heartbreaking story of friendship and devastating loss concerning two boys living in Nazi-occupied France. At a provincial Catholic boarding school, the precocious youths enjoy true camaraderie—until a secret is revealed. Based on events from writer-director Malle’s own childhood, the film is a subtle, precisely observed tale of courage, cowardice, and tragic awakening.
movies.title: Au Revoir les Enfants

movies.original_title: The Flintstones in Viva Rock Vegas
movies.overview: The Flintstones are at it again. The Flintstones and the Rubbles head for Rock Vegas with Fred hoping to court the lovely Wilma. Nothing will stand in the way of love, except for the conniving Chip Rockefeller who is the playboy born in Baysville but who has made it in the cutthroat town of Rock Vegas. Will Fred win Wilma's love?
movies.title: The Flintstones in Viva Rock Vegas
movies.tagline: Get ready to rock!

movies.overview: Annie is stuck in a long-term relationship with Duncan – an obsessive fan of obscure rocker Tucker Crowe. When the acoustic demo of Tucker's hit record from 25 years ago surfaces, its discovery leads to a life-changing encounter with the elusive rocker himself.
movies.title: Juliet, Naked

movies.overview: A one-time rodeo star and washed-up horse breeder takes a job from an ex-boss to bring the man's young son home from Mexico.
movies.title: Cry Macho
movies.tagline: A story of being lost... and found.

movies.overview: As the deceased soul Ja-hong and his three afterlife guardians prepare for their remaining trials for reincarnation, the guardians soon come face to face with the truth of their tragic time on Earth 1,000 years earlier.
movies.title: Along with the Gods: The Last 49 Days
movies.tagline: Unveiling millennium-old secrets.

movies.overview: When successful businessman Sam Treadwell finds that his android wife, Cherry model 2000 has blown a fuse, he hires sexy renegade tracker E. Johnson to find her exact duplicate. But as their journey to replace his perfect mate leads them into the treacherous and lawless region of 'The Zone', Treadwell learns the hard way that the perfect woman is made not of computer chips and diodes.
movies.title: Cherry 2000
movies.tagline: Need A Bounty Hunter? She's Your Man.

movies.original_title: Nanny McPhee and the Big Bang
movies.overview: Nanny McPhee appears at the door of a harried young mother who is trying to run the family farm while her husband is away at war. But once she’s arrived, Nanny discovers that the children are fighting a war of their own against two spoiled city cousins who have just moved in. Relying on everything from a flying motorcycle and a statue that comes to life to a tree-climbing piglet and a baby elephant, Nanny uses her magic to teach her mischievous charges five new lessons.
movies.title: Nanny McPhee and the Big Bang
movies.tagline: The magic's back, warts and all.

movies.overview: Four young friends, while taking a shortcut en route to a local boxing match, witness a brutal murder which leaves them running for their lives.
movies.title: Judgment Night
movies.tagline: Don't move. Don't whisper. Don't even breathe.

movies.overview: The living dead have taken over the world, and the remaining humans live in a walled city to protect themselves as they cope with the situation.
movies.title: Land of the Dead
movies.tagline: The Dead Shall Inherit the Earth.

movies.overview: The story of how a mysterious suitcase brings together, and changes, the lives of a divorced dad, an unhappy housewife, two hitmen, a pair of street thugs, two love struck teens, two FBI men and a psychedelic toad. Based on Pulitzer Prize-winning humorist Dave Barry's best-selling first novel, "Big Trouble."
movies.title: Big Trouble
movies.tagline: They have forty-five minutes to save the world. They need forty-six.

movies.overview: Two content creators get stuck in an empty pool and must fight for their survival against a ferocious, blood-thirsty creature.
movies.title: Tu Yaa Main
movies.tagline: Like. Share. Survive.

movies.overview: When a 10-year old girl goes missing, her stepfather races against time to investigate the kidnapping. Can he find her before it's too late?
movies.title: Ugly

movies.overview: Afflicted with a terminal illness John Bernard Books, the last of the legendary gunfighters, quietly returns to Carson City for medical attention from his old friend Dr. Hostetler. Aware that his days are numbered, the troubled man seeks solace and peace in a boarding house run by a widow and her son. However, it is not Books' fate to die in peace, as he becomes embroiled in one last valiant battle.
movies.title: The Shootist
movies.tagline: He's got to face a gunfight once more to live up to his legend once more. To win just one more time.

movies.overview: Eight medical students on a ski trip to Norway discover that Hitler's horrors live on when they come face to face with a battalion of zombie Nazi soldiers intent on devouring anyone unfortunate enough to wander into the remote mountains where they were once sent to die.
movies.title: Dead Snow
movies.tagline: Eins, Zwei, Die!

movies.overview: A mysterious diver hiding in Amsterdam's canal system embarks on a rampage of gruesome murders, terrifying city officials and leaving few clues for the city's best detective, who doesn't suspect that both his new girlfriend and twelve-year-old daughter may be closer than he is to finding the killer.
movies.title: Amsterdamned
movies.tagline: The danger lies just below the surface

movies.overview: England, 1600. Queen Elizabeth I promises Orlando, a young nobleman obsessed with poetry, that she will grant him land and fortune if he agrees to satisfy a very particular request.
movies.title: Orlando

movies.overview: A father comes to grips with his daughter’s upcoming wedding through the prism of multiple relationships within a big, sprawling Cuban-American family.
movies.title: Father of the Bride
movies.tagline: Love is simple. Family is not.

movies.overview: An eccentric, if not charming Southern professor and his crew pose as a band in order to rob a casino, all under the nose of his unsuspecting landlord – a sharp old woman.
movies.title: The Ladykillers
movies.tagline: The greatest criminal minds of all time have finally met their match.

movies.overview: When Reggie is abandoned on the mean city streets by his lowlife owner, Doug, Reggie is certain that his beloved owner would never leave him on purpose. But once Reggie falls in with Bug, a fast-talking, foul-mouthed stray who loves his freedom and believes that owners are for suckers, Reggie finally realizes he was in a toxic relationship and begins to see Doug for the heartless sleazeball that he is.
movies.title: Strays
movies.tagline: Go fetch yourself.

movies.overview: Powerful businessman Russ Duritz is self-absorbed and immersed in his work. But by the magic of the moon, he meets Rusty, a chubby, charming 8-year-old version of himself who can't believe he could turn out so badly – with no life and no dog. With Rusty's help, Russ is able to reconcile the person he used to dream of being with the man he's actually become.
movies.title: The Kid
movies.tagline: Nobody ever grows up quite like they imagined.

movies.overview: Jackie Moon is the owner, promoter, coach, and star player of the Flint Michigan Tropics of the American Basketball Association (ABA), the worst team in the league. In 1976 before the ABA collapses, the NBA plans to merge with the best teams of the ABA at the end of the season. Only the top four teams will make the move and the worst teams will fold. If the Tropics want to make it to the NBA, Jackie Moon must rally his team and start winning.
movies.title: Semi-Pro
movies.tagline: Putting the funk into the dunk.

movies.overview: Winner is a brilliant young misfit from Texas who finds her morals challenged while serving in the U.S. Air Force and working as an NSA contractor. A fresh take on the traditional whistleblower thriller, the coming-of-age story follows an idealistic young woman persecuted for standing by her principles.
movies.title: Winner
movies.tagline: Based on Reality.

movies.overview: A weekend at a marquis’ country château lays bare some ugly truths about a group of haut bourgeois acquaintances.
movies.title: The Rules of the Game

movies.overview: After assuming his dead cellmate's identity to get with his girlfriend, an ex-con finds himself the reluctant participant in a casino heist.
movies.title: Reindeer Games
movies.tagline: The trap is set. The game is on.

movies.overview: A demonic force has chosen Freddy Krueger as its portal to the real world. Can Heather Langenkamp play the part of Nancy one last time and trap the evil trying to enter our world?
movies.title: New Nightmare
movies.tagline: This time the terror doesn't stop at the screen.

belongs_to_collection.name: A Nightmare on Elm Street Collection

movies.overview: A Naval officer, reprimanded after Pearl Harbor, is later promoted to Rear Admiral and gets a second chance to prove himself against the Japanese.
movies.title: In Harm's Way
movies.tagline: Stripped of everything - they lived and loved and fought as if there were no tomorrow...

movies.original_title: Hearts of Darkness: A Filmmaker's Apocalypse
movies.overview: A chronicle of the production problems — including bad weather, actors' health, war near the filming locations, and more — which plagued the filming of Apocalypse Now, increasing costs and nearly destroying the life and career of Francis Ford Coppola.
movies.title: Hearts of Darkness: A Filmmaker's Apocalypse
movies.tagline: The magic and madness of making Apocalypse Now

movies.overview: A young couple who inherit a farm in rural Arkansas must conquer the demons, both physical and metaphysical, that haunt its legacy.
movies.title: King Snake

movies.overview: Twelve years after saving his daughter Arya from a dark force, Atharva learns it never left her. When strange events begin again, he must fight to save her once more.
movies.title: Vash Level 2
movies.tagline: You can only watch them suffer.

movies.overview: A single mom is raped by an invisible force. Her psychiatrist believes the experience stems from childhood trauma, while she knows something supernatural is at play.
movies.title: The Entity
movies.tagline: There is no escape from something you cannot see.

movies.overview: Recruited by the U.S. government to be a special agent, nerdy teenager Cody Banks must get closer to cute classmate Natalie in order to learn about an evil plan hatched by her father. But despite the agent persona, Cody struggles with teen angst.
movies.title: Agent Cody Banks
movies.tagline: Save the world. Get the girl. Pass math.

movies.overview: Passengers on a European train have been exposed to a deadly disease, and nobody will let them off the train.
movies.title: The Cassandra Crossing
movies.tagline: The Fear Is Spreading

movies.overview: On the verge of bankruptcy and desperate for his big break, aspiring filmmaker Bobby Bowfinger concocts a crazy plan to make his ultimate dream movie. Rallying a ragtag team that includes a starry-eyed ingenue, a has-been diva and a film studio gofer, he sets out to shoot a blockbuster featuring the biggest star in Hollywood, Kit Ramsey -- only without letting Ramsey know he's in the picture.
movies.title: Bowfinger
movies.tagline: The con is on.

movies.overview: Three young men bond together to escape volatile families in their Rust Belt hometown. As they face adult responsibilities, unexpected revelations threaten their decade-long friendship.
movies.title: Minding the Gap

movies.overview: Two elite soldiers must escort civilians through a gauntlet of gunfire and explosions.
movies.title: Hidden Strike
movies.tagline: There is a plan. They just don't know what it is.

movies.overview: A father and daughter are on their way to dance camp when they spot the girl's best friend on the side of the road. When they stop to offer the friend a ride, their good intentions soon result in terrible consequences.
movies.title: The Lie
movies.tagline: It was an accident.

movies.overview: A legendary TV star solves a murder mystery at her country estate.
movies.title: A Murder Between Friends
movies.tagline: Lock your bedroom doors tonight, one of you could be a murderer.

movies.overview: A few days before Christmas, traveling entertainer Marc Stevens is stuck at nightfall in a remote wood in the swampy Hautes Fagnes region of Liège when his van breaks down. An odd chap who's looking for a lost dog then leads Marc to a shuttered inn.
movies.title: Calvaire
movies.tagline: Some people would kill for company.

movies.overview: Third entry in the Smile franchise. Plot TBA.
movies.title: Smile 3

movies.overview: When a hopelessly romantic high school senior falls for a mysterious new classmate, it sets them both on an unexpected journey that teaches them about love, loss, and most importantly themselves.
movies.title: Chemical Hearts
movies.tagline: Fall in love. Fall apart.

movies.overview: When a foster home placed teenage rebel suspects that her father is not dead but kidnapped by UFOs, she takes help from a UFO association to find out the truth. Together, they embark on a risky adventure that takes them far beyond the laws borders and into a world filled with UFO expeditions, conspiracies and inexplicable phenomena.
movies.title: Watch the Skies
movies.tagline: To believe is one thing. To know is something completely different.

movies.overview: Frank Leone is nearing the end of his prison term for a relatively minor crime. Just before he is paroled, however, Warden Drumgoole takes charge. Drumgoole was assigned to a hell-hole prison after his administration was publicly humiliated by Leone, and has now arrived on the scene to ensure that Leone never sees the light of day.
movies.title: Lock Up
movies.tagline: How much can a man take...before he gives back?

movies.overview: A reporter's dream of becoming a news anchor is compromised after a one-night stand leaves her stranded in downtown L.A. without a phone, car, ID or money - and only 8 hours to make it to the most important job interview of her life.
movies.title: Walk of Shame
movies.tagline: Awesome night. Epic aftermath.

movies.overview: A passionate holiday romance leads to an obsessive relationship when an Australian photojournalist wakes one morning in an abandoned Berlin apartment and is unable to leave.
movies.title: Berlin Syndrome
movies.tagline: When passion becomes possession.

movies.overview: Travel writer Lemuel Gulliver takes an assignment in Bermuda, but ends up on the island of Liliput, where he towers over its tiny citizens.
movies.title: Gulliver's Travels
movies.tagline: Something big is going down.

movies.overview: The true story of Saúl Armendáriz, a gay amateur wrestler from El Paso that rises to international stardom after he creates the character Cassandro, the “Liberace of Lucha Libre.” In the process, he upends not just the macho wrestling world but also his own life.
movies.title: Cassandro
movies.tagline: Changing the game, one match at a time.

movies.overview: Siblings Mimi and Luke unwittingly resurrect an ancient alien overlord. Using a magical amulet, they force the monster to obey their childish whims, and accidentally attract a rogues’ gallery of intergalactic assassins to small-town suburbia.
movies.title: PG: Psycho Goreman
movies.tagline: Little girl. Big psycho.

movies.overview: With the help of a talking freeway billboard, a "wacky weatherman" tries to win the heart of an English newspaper reporter, who is struggling to make sense of the strange world of early-90s Los Angeles.
movies.title: L.A. Story
movies.tagline: Something funny is happening in L.A.

movies.overview: Kongwen Lu is the author of a fantasy novel series following a heroic teenager, also named Kongwen, on a quest to end the tyrannical rule of Lord Redmane, under the guidance of a Black Armor. But through a strange twist of fate, the fantasy world of the novel begins to impact life in the real world, leading Guan Ning to accept a mission from Tu Ling to kill the author.
movies.title: A Writer's Odyssey
movies.tagline: Rewrite the reality.

movies.overview: Recent MIT grad Matt Franklin should be well on his way to a successful career at a Fortune 500 company, but instead he rebels against maturity by taking a job at a video store. Matt rethinks his position when his unrequited high-school crush, Tori, walks in and invites him to an end-of-summer party. With the help of his twin sister and his best friend, Matt hatches a plan to change the course of his life.
movies.title: Take Me Home Tonight
movies.tagline: Best. Night. Ever.

movies.overview: To Make It Back Home is the story of a man who has lost his place to stand in life, embarking on a long journey through his own inner emptiness and the unseen wounds of the country. As Anıl drifts between cities, people, and events, he is forced to confront loss, guilt, and a deep sense of not belonging. Everywhere he believes he has escaped to, he encounters the same void. Home ceases to be an address and becomes a reckoning with the past, family, and himself.
movies.title: To Make It Back Home

movies.overview: Michelle is enjoying a peaceful retirement in a Burgundy village, close to her longtime friend Marie-Claude. When her Parisian daughter Valérie drops off her son Lucas to spend school vacation with his grandma, Michelle, stressed out by her daughter, serves her toxic mushrooms for lunch. Valérie quickly recovers, but forbids her mother from seeing her grandson anymore. Feeling lonely and guilty, Michelle falls into a depression... until Marie-Claude's son gets out of prison.
movies.title: When Fall Is Coming

movies.overview: Traveling through an unnamed European country on the brink of war, sickly, intellectual Ester, her sister Anna and Anna's young son, Johan, check into a near-empty hotel. A basic inability to communicate among the three seems only to worsen during their stay. Anna provokes her sister by enjoying a dalliance with a local man, while the boy, left to himself, has a series of enigmatic encounters that heighten the growing air of isolation.
movies.title: The Silence
movies.tagline: BERGMAN at his most POWERFUL! SHOCKING! BOLD!

movies.original_title: Don't Worry, He Won't Get Far on Foot
movies.overview: On the rocky path to sobriety after a life-changing accident, John Callahan discovers the healing power of art, willing his injured hands into drawing hilarious, often controversial cartoons, which bring him a new lease on life.
movies.title: Don't Worry, He Won't Get Far on Foot
movies.tagline: Don't just sit there. Do nothing.

movies.overview: As Agnes slowly dies of cancer, her sisters are so immersed in their own psychic pains that they are unable to offer her the support she needs.
movies.title: Cries and Whispers
movies.tagline: Four women dressed in white in a mansion painted red... haunted by whispers and cries.

movies.overview: One woman's journey for self-discovery and turns into a harrowing tale of survival.
movies.title: Infinite Storm

movies.overview: A once-promising Naval commander is blackmailed by a cartel-like operation into piloting a dangerous submarine carrying illegal cargo across international waters. Thrust into a high-stakes game of cat and mouse, the man must outmaneuver blockades and navigate perilous threats both in and outside of the submarine.
movies.title: Subversion

movies.overview: Ali G unwittingly becomes a pawn in the evil Chancellor's plot to overthrow the Prime Minister of Great Britain. However, instead of bringing the Prime Minister down, Ali is embraced by the nation as the voice of youth and 'realness', making the Prime Minister and his government more popular than ever.
movies.title: Ali G Indahouse
movies.tagline: Me iz introducin a white paper.

movies.overview: A retired businesswoman – who tries to control everything around her – decides to write her own obituary. A young journalist takes up the task of finding out the truth, and the result is a life-altering friendship.
movies.title: The Last Word
movies.tagline: An unexpected friendship that began at the end.

movies.original_title: Night at the Museum: Kahmunrah Rises Again
movies.overview: Nick Daley is following in his father's footsteps as night watchman at the American Museum of Natural History, so he knows what happens when the sun goes down. But when the maniacal ruler Kahmunrah escapes, it is up to Nick to save the museum once and for all.
movies.title: Night at the Museum: Kahmunrah Rises Again
movies.tagline: Same shift. Different night.

movies.overview: A female forensic psychiatrist discovers that all of one of her patient's multiple personalities are murder victims. She will have to find out what's happening before her time is finished.
movies.title: 6 Souls
movies.tagline: Evil will rise.

movies.overview: In 1996, Tsurisaki Kiyotaka, one of Japan’s most infamous death photographers, ventured into the center of Hell itself - the Rue Morgue neighborhood of Bogota, Colombia. With death and murder rampant, the corpses eventually find their way to embalmer Froilan Orozco, who has been tending the dead for over 50 years. We watch as bodies are brought in to his shop and he prepares them for their funerals.
movies.title: Orozco the Embalmer

movies.overview: The "black sheep" son of a wealthy family meets a young psychiatric patient who's been raised in isolation her entire life. He takes the naive young woman home for his brother's wedding an improbable romance blooms, as she impresses everyone with her genuine, simple charms.
movies.title: Barefoot
movies.tagline: She's stepping out into the world.

movies.overview: Eddie Vedder's soul-stirring Seattle benefit concert fuels this documentary about the race to cure the rare genetic disorder epidermolysis bullosa (EB).
movies.title: Matter of Time
movies.tagline: Music. Community. Hope.

movies.overview: After a wild one-night stand, successful sports agent Derrick Tyler watches his perfect life slowly disappear when he discovers the sexy and mysterious woman he risked everything for is determined police detective Valerie Quinlan who entangles him in her latest investigation. As he desperately tries to put the pieces together, he falls deeper into her trap, risking his family, his career, and even his life.
movies.title: Fatale
movies.tagline: One mistake can change your life.

movies.overview: Two championship rodeo partners travel to New York to find their missing friend, Nacho Salazar who went missing there.
movies.title: The Cowboy Way
movies.tagline: How the East was won.

movies.overview: Three friends, whose lives have been drifting apart, reunite for the funeral of a fourth childhood friend. When looking through their childhood belongings, they discover a trunk which contained details on a quest their friend was attempting. It revealed that he was hot on the trail of the $200,000 that went missing with airplane hijacker D.B. Cooper in 1971. They decide to continue his journey, but do not understand the dangers they will soon encounter.
movies.title: Without a Paddle
movies.tagline: The call of the wild. The thrill of adventure. The mistake of a lifetime.

movies.overview: The lives of two Danish families cross each other, and an extraordinary but risky friendship comes into bud. But loneliness, frailty and sorrow lie in wait.
movies.title: In a Better World

movies.original_title: The Nutcracker and the Four Realms
movies.overview: When Clara’s mother leaves her a mysterious gift, she embarks on a journey to four secret realms—where she discovers her greatest strength could change the world.
movies.title: The Nutcracker and the Four Realms
movies.tagline: Let the mystery unfold.

movies.overview: Su-yeon, a cellist in an orchestra led by her fiancé and conductor Sung-jin, disappears one day, leaving behind only a video recording. Sung-jin is devasted over the loss of Su-yeon, but feels a strong attraction to Mi-ju, a cellist who fills in for his fiancée. Then one rainy night, Sung-jin and Mi-ju get swept away by their mutual desires for each other and commit an unforgivable act at Su-yeon's house.
movies.title: Hidden Face
movies.tagline: Secrets revealed, fouled desire.

movies.overview: James Bowen, a homeless busker and recovering drug addict, has his life transformed when he meets a stray ginger cat.
movies.title: A Street Cat Named Bob
movies.tagline: Sometimes it takes nine lives to save one

movies.overview: Kabul, August 15, 2021. US troops are preparing to withdraw from Afghanistan, while the Taliban are marching on the capital to seize power. Amid the chaos, Commander Mohamed Bida and his men are in charge of security at the French embassy, the last Western mission to remain open. Trapped along with 500 people, left to their own devices, the team must reach the airport at all costs. A perilous mission with no guarantee of success to flee the hell of Kabul and rescue what remains of humanity.
movies.title: 13 Days, 13 Nights: In the Hell of Kabul

movies.overview: A faulty computer causes a passenger space shuttle to head straight for the sun, and man-with-a-past Ted Striker must save the day and get the shuttle back on track – again – all the while trying to patch up his relationship with Elaine.
movies.title: Airplane II: The Sequel
movies.tagline: For the ride of your life... All you need for Christmas are your two front seats!

movies.overview: Stephen Seary, a stage designer, returns to Australia to visit his dying mother, but a quick trip descends into family tensions, past conflicts, and romantic complications, jeopardizing his return to Europe and the opera that awaits.
movies.title: The Travellers

movies.overview: One of the most celebrated war correspondents of our time, Marie Colvin is an utterly fearless and rebellious spirit, driven to the frontlines of conflicts across the globe to give voice to the voiceless.
movies.title: A Private War
movies.tagline: The most powerful weapon is the truth.
