movies.overview: When her boyfriend dumps Emily, a spontaneous woman in her 30s, she persuades her ultra-cautious mom to accompany her on a vacation to Ecuador. When these two very different women are trapped on this wild journey, their bond as mother and daughter is tested and strengthened while they attempt to navigate the jungle and escape.
movies.title: Snatched
movies.tagline: Mess with me, mess with my mother.

movies.overview: Venerable newscaster Norm Archer reports the latest news in politics, health, culture and entertainment - such as an automotive recall of decapitation-inducing "Neckbelts" and a study finding that "depression hits losers hardest". This compilation of bogus news stories, celebrity profiles, movie trailers and skits come courtesy of the ace satirists at The Onion.
movies.title: The Onion Movie
movies.tagline: America's finest news source.

movies.overview: Katherine Morrissey, a former Christian missionary, lost her faith after the tragic deaths of her family. Now she applies her expertise to debunking religious phenomena. When a series of biblical plagues overrun a small town, Katherine arrives to prove that a supernatural force is not behind the occurrences, but soon finds that science cannot explain what is happening. Instead, she must regain her faith to combat the evil that waits in a Louisiana swamp.
movies.title: The Reaping
movies.tagline: Thousands of years ago, there was a series of bizarre occurrences that many believe to have been the Ten Biblical Plagues. No one thought they could happen again. Until now.

movies.overview: When Erin Bell was a young cop, she was given an undercover assignment that ended badly and destroyed her life. Years later, she must face her demons in order to make peace with her past.
movies.title: Destroyer
movies.tagline: There's nothing to lose when you've already lost everything

movies.overview: Marko, an aspiring filmmaker, is unable to pursue a career in horror films. He ventures into the porn industry, but his unorthodox style fails to impress producers. Frustrated, he assembles a crew of junkies, homosexuals and transvestites and starts a traveling live porn show. Soon a shady producer appears, he will pay them real money if they are willing to start making snuff films for him.
movies.title: The Life and Death of a Porno Gang

movies.overview: Willie Dynamite is a pimp who operates in New York City. Willie was a big success as a pimp, but now, just as fast as he rose to the top, he has hit bottom. A former prostitute who has become a social worker tries to get Willie to clean up his life while it is still possible.
movies.title: Willie Dynamite
movies.tagline: Ain't no one crosses WILLIE "D." He's tight, together, and mean. Chicks, Chumps, he uses 'em all. He's got to be Number-One.

movies.overview: When a US Naval captain shows signs of mental instability that jeopardize his ship, the first officer relieves him of command and faces court martial for mutiny.
movies.title: The Caine Mutiny
movies.tagline: As big as the ocean!

movies.overview: When his boss is killed, Detroit cop Axel Foley finds evidence that the murderer had ties to a California amusement park called Wonder World. Returning to sunny Beverly Hills once more, Foley reunites with Detective Billy Rosewood to solve the case. Along with Billy's new partner, Detective Jon Flint, they discover that Wonder World is being used as a front for a massive counterfeiting ring.
movies.title: Beverly Hills Cop III
movies.tagline: In for the ride of his life.

movies.overview: A young black pianist becomes embroiled in the lives of an upper-class white family set among the racial tensions, infidelity, violence, and other nostalgic events in early 1900s New York City.
movies.title: Ragtime
movies.tagline: The passion, the violence, the birth of America's Gilded Age.

movies.overview: Two planes almost collide after a blinding flash of light paralyzes air traffic controller Dylan Branson for a few seconds. Suspended from his job, Dylan starts to notice an ominous pattern of sounds and events that repeats itself in exactly the same manner every day, ending precisely at 2:22 p.m. Also drawn into a complex relationship with a woman, Dylan must figure out a way to break the power of the past and take control of time itself.
movies.tagline: To save their future, he must fight his fate.

movies.overview: Recounted mostly through animation to protect his identity, Amin looks back over his past as a child refugee from Afghanistan as he grapples with a secret he’s kept hidden for 20 years.
movies.title: Flee
movies.tagline: Sometimes it takes years to start living your life

movies.overview: In a contemporary New York City, members of a dysfunctional family of vampires are trying to come to terms with each other, in the wake of their father's death. Meanwhile, they are being hunted by Dr. Van Helsing and his hapless nephew. As in all good vampire movies, forces of love are pitted against forces of destruction.
movies.title: Nadja
movies.tagline: Unseen. Unforgiving. Undead.

movies.overview: After the fall of civilization, the few survivors have been driven to cannibalism. A young man must confront a violent tribe that has murdered his father and stolen the medicine that keeps his girlfriend alive.
movies.title: Year 10
movies.tagline: Survival is deadly.

movies.overview: Papa Zola, a schoolteacher, and his gifted daughter Pipi go on small adventures that often escalate. Their escapades showcase their loving relationship and Pipi's intelligence, as they navigate whimsical situations together.
movies.title: Papa Zola: The Movie

movies.overview: North Carolina mountains at the end of the 1920s – George and Serena Pemberton, love-struck newly-weds, begin to build a timber empire. Serena soon proves herself to be equal to any man: overseeing loggers, hunting rattle-snakes, even saving a man’s life in the wilderness. With power and influence now in their hands, the Pembertons refuse to let anyone stand in the way of their inflated love and ambitions. However, once Serena discovers George’s hidden past and faces an unchangeable fate of her own, the Pemberton’s passionate marriage begins to unravel leading toward a dramatic reckoning.
movies.title: Serena
movies.tagline: Some loves can never let go.

movies.overview: A young drug-addled writer approaching the bottom of his descent submits to two months of agonizing detox at a treatment center in Minnesota.
movies.title: A Million Little Pieces
movies.tagline: I'm fine.

movies.overview: A fatally ill mother with only two months to live creates a list of things she wants to do before she dies without telling her family of her illness.
movies.title: My Life Without Me
movies.tagline: What you are… is what you leave behind.

movies.overview: A soon-to-be bride on her way to a wedding rehearsal is having second thoughts and decides to take a detour. Her car breaks down and a hitch-hiker offers help. Could it be fate?
movies.title: Curve

movies.overview: Crazed members of a sadistic family return to their childhood home to terrorize the new owners.
movies.title: Mother's Day
movies.tagline: Don't Misbehave.

movies.original_title: バイオハザード：デスアイランド
movies.overview: In San Francisco, Jill Valentine is dealing with a zombie outbreak and a new T-Virus, Leon Kennedy is on the trail of a kidnapped DARPA scientist, and Claire Redfield is investigating a monstrous fish that is killing whales in the bay. Joined by Chris Redfield and Rebecca Chambers, they discover the trail of clues from their separate cases all converge on the same location, Alcatraz Island, where a new evil has taken residence and awaits their arrival.
movies.title: Resident Evil: Death Island
movies.tagline: Destinies intertwined. A world gone mad.

movies.overview: Acclaimed writer and historian Deborah E. Lipstadt must battle for historical truth to prove the Holocaust actually occurred when David Irving, a renowned denier, sues her for libel.
movies.title: Denial
movies.tagline: The whole world knows the Holocaust happened. Now she needs to prove it.

movies.overview: Will center around a shark attack. Plot TBA.
movies.title: Untitled Shark Thriller

movies.overview: A devout Mormon living in L.A. becomes a pornographic actor after his martial arts moves impress a big-time director.
movies.title: Orgazmo
movies.tagline: Fighting crime never felt so good!

movies.original_title: 人間の條件　第３部望郷篇／第４部戦雲篇
movies.overview: Kaji is sent to the Japanese army labeled Red and is mistreated by the vets. Along his assignment, Kaji witnesses cruelties in the army and revolts against the abusive treatment against the recruit Obara. He also sees his friend Shinjô Ittôhei defecting to the Russian border, and he ends in the front to fight a lost battle against the Russian tanks division.
movies.title: The Human Condition II: Road to Eternity
movies.tagline: The second one

movies.overview: A former Marine and his old war buddy face off against the Mexican cartel behind the disappearance of his daughter.
movies.title: Shrapnel
movies.tagline: They're going to war for his daughter.

movies.overview: Bruno loved his job as a middle manager at a paper company, but optimistically views being laid off as an opportunity. After two years of searching for a comparable position, optimism turns to desperation. His wife works two jobs, and their marriage slowly deteriorates as their hold on the middle class slips away. Bruno concocts a grimly audacious plan to identify and kill his fellow job applicants so that he is the only qualified person left.
movies.title: The Ax
movies.tagline: Some people would die to get (him) this job.

movies.overview: A widow with three children hires a handyman to fix her house during a major storm. When not doing home repairs, he shares his philosophy of believing in the power of the universe to deliver what we want.
movies.title: The Secret: Dare to Dream

movies.overview: An off-duty SAS soldier, Tom Buckingham, must thwart a terror attack on a train running through the Channel Tunnel. As the action escalates on the train, events transpire in the corridors of power that may make the difference as to whether Buckingham and the civilian passengers make it out of the tunnel alive.
movies.title: SAS: Red Notice

movies.overview: Successful movie director John L. Sullivan, convinced he won't be able to film his ambitious masterpiece until he has suffered, dons a hobo disguise and sets off on a journey, aiming to "know trouble" first-hand. When all he finds is a train ride back to Hollywood and a beautiful blonde companion, he redoubles his efforts, managing to land himself in more trouble than he bargained for when he loses his memory and ends up a prisoner on a chain gang.
movies.title: Sullivan's Travels
movies.tagline: Veronica Lake’s on the Take

movies.original_title: Vampyr - Der Traum des Allan Grey
movies.overview: Allan Gray, a young man fascinated by the supernatural, goes to a small village where he feels a sinister force descending upon him. There, Allan meets an old man who asks him to protect his two daughters, for one of them has been bitten by a vampire.
movies.title: Vampyr
movies.tagline: The strange adventure of Allan Gray.

movies.overview: An estranged family gathers together in New York for an event celebrating the artistic work of their father.
movies.title: The Meyerowitz Stories (New and Selected)

movies.original_title: The Witcher: Nightmare of the Wolf
movies.overview: Escaping from poverty to become a witcher, Vesemir slays monsters for coin and glory, but when a new menace rises, he must face the demons of his past.
movies.title: The Witcher: Nightmare of the Wolf
movies.tagline: Face your demons.

movies.overview: Will Keane, a Manhattan restaurateur, is content with his playboy lifestyle until he meets Charlotte Fielding, a free-spirited young woman. Together the pair pursue a passionate affair that forces them both to reevaluate what they want out of life, even as fate threatens to steal away their future.
movies.title: Autumn in New York
movies.tagline: He fell in love for the first time. She fell in love forever.

movies.overview: A Michigan farmer and a prospector form a partnership in the California gold country. Their adventures include buying and sharing a wife, hijacking a stage, kidnapping six prostitutes, and turning their mining camp into a boom town. Along the way there is plenty of drinking, gambling, and singing. They even find time to do some creative gold mining.
movies.title: Paint Your Wagon
movies.tagline: Stake Your Claim To The Musical Goldmine of '69!

movies.overview: A village official attending a wedding becomes entangled in an escalating family dispute over power and old resentments, testing his leadership as he tries to contain the situation.
movies.title: Thalaivar Thambi Thalaimaiyil

movies.overview: From Spike Lee comes this vibrant semi-autobiographical portrait of a school-teacher, her stubborn jazz-musician husband and their five kids living in '70s Brooklyn.
movies.title: Crooklyn
movies.tagline: A new look at the old neighborhood.

movies.original_title: Greystoke: The Legend of Tarzan, Lord of the Apes
movies.overview: A shipping disaster in the 19th Century has stranded a man and woman in the wilds of Africa. The lady is pregnant, and gives birth to a son in their tree house. Soon after, a family of apes stumble across the house and in the ensuing panic, both parents are killed. A female ape takes the tiny boy as a replacement for her own dead infant, and raises him as her son. Twenty years later, Captain Phillippe D'Arnot discovers the man who thinks he is an ape. Evidence in the tree house leads him to believe that he is the direct descendant of the Earl of Greystoke, and thus takes it upon himself to return the man to civilization.
movies.title: Greystoke: The Legend of Tarzan, Lord of the Apes

movies.overview: When Ben Wrightman, a young teacher, begins dating pretty businesswoman Lindsey Meeks, the two don't seem to have a lot of the same interests, but they fall in love, regardless. Their romance goes well until baseball season begins, and Lindsey soon realizes that Ben is completely obsessed with the Boston Red Sox. Though she tries to understand Ben's passionate team loyalty, eventually it threatens to end their otherwise happy relationship.
movies.title: Fever Pitch
movies.tagline: A comedy about the game of love.

movies.overview: Arun and Darshana are first-year engineering students and they fall in love soon after their college begins. And just as how things work generally in teenage, the road ahead isn't too easy for them. Life offers many twists and turns that they least expect.
movies.title: Hridayam

movies.original_title: The Lair of the White Worm
movies.overview: When an archaeologist uncovers a strange skull in a foreign land, the residents of a nearby town begin to disappear, leading to further inexplicable occurrences.
movies.title: The Lair of the White Worm
movies.tagline: Some legends really bite.

movies.overview: A Rookie cop named Denny Colt returns from the beyond as The Spirit, a hero whose mission is to fight against the bad forces from the shadows of Central City.  The Octopus, who kills anyone unfortunate enough to see his face, has other plans; he is going to wipe out the entire city.
movies.title: The Spirit
movies.tagline: Down these mean streets a man must come. A hero born, murdered, and born again.

movies.overview: After a wealthy heiress is murdered in her beach house, her devastated husband becomes the prime suspect. He hires a lawyer who hasn’t taken a criminal case in years, and as they work together, a complicated romance develops amidst the trial.
movies.title: Jagged Edge
movies.tagline: When a murder case is this shocking, which do you trust? Your emotions or your evidence?

movies.overview: The lives of Sita and her daughter, Gendis, change after a terrifying night. Their journey through Alas Roban is filled with fear and relentless terror. Can they uncover what's happening there?
movies.title: Alas Roban

movies.overview: A struggling painter is possessed by satanic forces after he and his young family move into their dream home in rural Texas.
movies.title: The Devil's Candy
movies.tagline: He Will Slither into your Soul.

movies.overview: Thirteen-year-old Marcielle lives on Marajó Island in the heart of the Amazon rainforest. To break a terrible cycle that imprisons the women around her in an isolated region, she must do the impossible to liberate herself and her younger sister from a dark abyss of silence held by her own family.
movies.title: Manas

movies.overview: A former serial killer with Alzheimer's fights to protect his daughter from her mysterious boyfriend who may be a serial killer too.
movies.title: Memoir of a Murderer
movies.tagline: Memories can deceive you.

movies.overview: In the year of 2039, after World Wars destroy much of the civilization as we know it, territories are no longer run by governments, but by corporations; the mightiest of which is the Mishima Zaibatsu. In order to placate the seething masses of this dystopia, Mishima sponsors Tekken, a tournament in which fighters battle until only one is left standing.
movies.title: Tekken
movies.tagline: Survival is no game

movies.overview: When a impoverished widow’s family moves to the big city, two of her five sons become romantic rivals with deadly results.
movies.title: Rocco and His Brothers
movies.tagline: DARING in its realism. STUNNING in its impact. BREATHTAKING in its scope.

movies.overview: A family find themselves terrorized by their eight-year-old son's imaginary friend.
movies.title: Z
movies.tagline: Z wants to play

movies.overview: One summer, a French teenager who has been living with his mother in the city moves in with his estranged father’s family in the countryside, where he clashes with his stepmother.
movies.title: Last Summer

movies.overview: A boy tries to stop aliens that have taken over his town and are brainwashing its inhabitants.
movies.title: Invaders from Mars
movies.tagline: Their conquest has already begun. . . . He knows they’re here.

movies.overview: Nedumaaran Rajangam "Maara" sets out to make the common man fly and in the process takes on the world's most capital intensive industry and several enemies who stand in his way.
movies.title: Soorarai Pottru

movies.overview: Talented rookie race-car driver Jimmy Bly has started losing his focus and begins to slip in the race rankings. It's no wonder, with the immense pressure being shoveled on him by his overly ambitious promoter brother as well as Bly's romance with his arch rival's girlfriend Sophia. With much riding on Bly, car owner Carl Henry brings former racing star Joe Tanto on board to help Bly. To drive Bly back to the top of the rankings, Tanto must first deal with the emotional scars left over from a tragic racing accident which nearly took his life.
movies.title: Driven
movies.tagline: Get ready for the race of your life.

movies.overview: A small business owner is about to lose her shop to a major corporate development.
movies.title: They Came Together
movies.tagline: He came...She came...They both came

movies.overview: On a cold Monday morning, a group of counselors clock in at an old-fashioned social services office. Their task is to interview the recently deceased, record their personal details, then, over the course of the week, assist them in choosing a single memory to keep for eternity.
movies.title: After Life
movies.tagline: What is the one memory you would take with you?

movies.overview: After fierce Roman commander Marcus Vinicius becomes infatuated with beautiful Christian hostage Lygia, he begins to question the tyrannical leadership of the despotic emperor Nero.
movies.title: Quo Vadis
movies.tagline: THIS IS THE BIG ONE! The splendor and savagery of the world's wickedest empire! Three hours of spectacle you'll remember for a lifetime!

movies.original_title: さよならの朝に約束の花をかざろう
movies.overview: Fleeing the war, the immortal Machia, graced with eternal youth, finds a baby abandoned in the forest and decides to raise it as her own child, sparking a moving story between a mortal and a being who does not age.
movies.title: Maquia: When the Promised Flower Blooms
movies.tagline: I weave my life with yours.

movies.overview: A political activist is convinced that her guest is a man who once tortured her for the government.
movies.title: Death and the Maiden
movies.tagline: Prepare yourself for the moment of truth.

movies.overview: A group of friends venture into the remote Texas woods for a party weekend and find themselves stalked by Bigfoot.
movies.title: Exists
movies.tagline: The legend is real. So is the terror.

movies.overview: Seemingly opposite street hoopers, Jeremy, an injury prone former star, and Kamal, a has-been prodigy, team up to take one final shot at living out their dreams.
movies.title: White Men Can't Jump
movies.tagline: Play hard. Hustle harder.

movies.overview: Affable hit man Melvin Smiley is constantly being scammed by his cutthroat colleagues in the life-ending business. So, when he and his fellow assassins kidnap the daughter of an electronics mogul, it's naturally Melvin who takes the fall when their prime score turns sour. That's because the girl is the goddaughter of the gang's ruthless crime boss. But, even while dodging bullets, Melvin has to keep his real job secret from his unsuspecting fiancée, Pam.
movies.title: The Big Hit
movies.tagline: Nothing's more dangerous than some nice guys... with a little time to kill.

movies.overview: Unemployed and recently dumped, Mitch and his buddy Sam start a revenge-for-hire business to raise the $50,000 that Sam's father needs to get a heart transplant.
movies.title: Dirty Work
movies.tagline: Revenge is sweet. (And surprisingly affordable.)

movies.overview: A young woman returns a lonely widow’s lost purse, leading to an unlikely relationship between the two — until the young woman discovers the widow might not be all that she seems.
movies.title: Greta
movies.tagline: Everyone needs a friend.

movies.overview: Dr. Peter Blood, unjustly convicted of treason and exiled from England, becomes a notorious pirate.
movies.title: Captain Blood
movies.tagline: A million dollars worth of adventure!

movies.overview: The true story of the relationship between Alan Bennett and the singular Miss Shepherd, a woman of uncertain origins who ‘temporarily’ parked her van in Bennett’s London driveway and proceeded to live there for 15 years.
movies.title: The Lady in the Van
movies.tagline: A mostly true story

movies.overview: Teenager Les Anderson thinks his life can't get any worse after he flunks his driver's exam, but he's wrong. Even though he didn't receive his license, Les refuses to break his date with the cool Mercedes Lane, and he decides to lift his family's prize luxury car for the occasion. Unfortunately, Mercedes sneaks some booze along and passes out drunk, and a confused Les makes the bad decision of enlisting his rebellious friend, Dean, to help.
movies.title: License to Drive
movies.tagline: Some guys get all the brakes!

movies.overview: Middle-class housewife Kay Miniver deals with petty problems. She and her husband Clem watch her Oxford-educated son Vin court Carol Beldon, the charming granddaughter of the local nobility as represented by Lady Beldon. Then the war comes and Vin joins the RAF.
movies.title: Mrs. Miniver
movies.tagline: "Mrs. Miniver" is more than a picture... It's dramatic. It's tender. It's human. It's real.

movies.overview: In the midst of a civil war, a pair of former violinists in a tempestuous marriage oversee a farm on a rural island. In spite of their best efforts to escape their homeland, the war impinges on every aspect of their lives.
movies.title: Shame

movies.overview: In 1775 during the Spanish colonial period in the Philippines, nuns attempts to survive the night after an unknown evil was set free in their cloister. Meanwhile in 2025, a group of friends attend a Halloween masquerade ball which was attacked by a serial killer. Fast forward to the future in 2050, a post-apocalytic Philippines is ruled by the aswang.
movies.title: Shake, Rattle & Roll: Evil Origins

movies.overview: An Indian spy is married to a Pakistani military officer during the Indo-Pakistani War of 1971.
movies.title: Raazi
movies.tagline: An Incredible True Story

movies.overview: Experienced Green Beret sergeant Johnny Gallagher is escorting a prisoner, Airborne Ranger Thomas Boyette, back to the US, but Boyette escapes and Gallagher must risk life and limb to catch him.
movies.title: The Package
movies.tagline: He's one man racing against time to stop the most explosive conspiracy in history.

movies.overview: On a trip to her hometown, workaholic Ally reminisces with her first love, Sean, and starts to question everything about the person she's become. Things only get more confusing when she meets Sean's fiancé, Cassidy, who reminds her of the person she used to be.
movies.title: Somebody I Used to Know
movies.tagline: The past will bare it all.

movies.overview: 'Monster Cop' Ma Seok-do investigates an illegal online gambling business led by a former STS Baek and an IT genius CEO Chang. Ma proposes an unexpected alliance to Jang and begins hunting down the criminals.
movies.title: The Roundup: Punishment
movies.tagline: Time for the ultimate wipeout.

movies.overview: An outcast teenager, Pauline, practices surgical skills and harbors increasingly violent psychosexual fantasies.
movies.title: Excision
movies.tagline: Heal The Sickness

movies.overview: Forced underground by the next ice age, a struggling outpost of survivors must fight to preserve humanity against a threat even more savage than nature.
movies.title: The Colony
movies.tagline: One day, it started to snow .. and it never stopped

movies.overview: Darius Lovehall is a young black poet in Chicago who starts dating Nina Moseley, a beautiful and talented photographer. While trying to figure out if they've got a "love thing" or are just "kicking it," they hang out with their friends, talking about love and sex. Then Nina tests the strength of Darius' feelings and sets a chain of romantic complications into motion.
movies.title: Love Jones
movies.tagline: Get Together. Fall Apart. Start Over.

movies.overview: The dramatised story of the Irish civil rights protest march on January 30 1972 which ended in a massacre by British troops.
movies.title: Bloody Sunday

movies.overview: During the final days of the Vietnam War, Navy SEAL Mike Thornton leads a desperate last stand after five men are trapped behind enemy lines in North Vietnam. Outnumbered by an army of 150 soldiers, they fight through relentless enemy fire before making a harrowing retreat into the South China Sea. With both a gravely wounded lieutenant and fellow soldier tied to him, Thornton swims for hours through hostile waters to reach safety, an act of valor that earned him the Congressional Medal of Honor.
movies.title: Untitled NAVY Seal Film

movies.overview: A police officer faces a personal meltdown following a divorce and the death of his mother.
movies.title: Thunder Road
movies.tagline: Officer Arnaud loved his Mom.

movies.overview: When Robin meets the lovely Jamika he thinks he's in heaven. But when he meets her friend Bebe's children, whom she is looking after, he knows he's in hell.
movies.title: Bebe's Kids
movies.tagline: It's animation... with an attitude.

movies.overview: A rising star at agri-industry giant Archer Daniels Midland (ADM), Mark Whitacre suddenly turns whistleblower. Even as he exposes his company’s multi-national price-fixing conspiracy to the FBI, Whitacre envisions himself being hailed as a hero of the common man and handed a promotion.
movies.title: The Informant!
movies.tagline: Based on a tattle-tale

movies.overview: A celebrated author takes a journey with some old friends to have some fun and heal old wounds. Her nephew comes along to wrangle the ladies and finds himself involved with a young literary agent.
movies.title: Let Them All Talk
movies.tagline: Write your wrongs

movies.overview: A thirsty teenager's home video leads to a series of horrifying revelations, harkening back to the final punk rock analog days of VHS, while taking one giant leap forward into the hellish new millennium.
movies.title: V/H/S/99
movies.tagline: VHS goes to hell.

movies.overview: One thousand years after cataclysmic events forced humanity's escape from Earth, Nova Prime has become mankind's new home. Legendary General Cypher Raige returns from an extended tour of duty to his estranged family, ready to be a father to his 13-year-old son, Kitai. When an asteroid storm damages Cypher and Kitai's craft, they crash-land on a now unfamiliar and dangerous Earth. As his father lies dying in the cockpit, Kitai must trek across the hostile terrain to recover their rescue beacon. His whole life, Kitai has wanted nothing more than to be a soldier like his father. Today, he gets his chance.
movies.title: After Earth
movies.tagline: Danger is real, fear is a choice.

movies.overview: Barley Scott Blair, a Lisbon-based editor of Russian literature who unexpectedly begins working for British intelligence, is commissioned to investigate the purposes of Dante, a dissident scientist trapped in the decaying Soviet Union that is crumbling under the new open-minded policies.
movies.title: The Russia House
movies.tagline: Their love was as dangerous as the secrets they kept.

movies.overview: A quirky Sri Lankan family seeking a fresh start in India transforms a disconnected neighborhood into a vibrant community with their infectious love and kindness.
movies.title: Tourist Family

movies.original_title: 좋은 놈, 나쁜 놈, 이상한 놈
movies.overview: The story of three Korean outlaws in 1930s Manchuria and their dealings with the Japanese army and Chinese and Russian bandits. The Good (a bounty hunter), the Bad (a hitman), and the Weird (a thief) battle the army and the bandits in a race to use a treasure map to uncover the riches of legend.
movies.title: The Good, the Bad, the Weird
movies.tagline: One map. Three villains. Winner takes all.

movies.original_title: ドロステのはてで僕ら
movies.overview: A cafe owner discovers that the TV in his cafe suddenly shows images from the future, but only two minutes into the future.
movies.title: Beyond the Infinite Two Minutes
movies.tagline: A one-take time travel Sci-fi comedy!

movies.overview: A ventriloquist is at the mercy of his vicious dummy while he tries to renew a romance with his high school sweetheart.
movies.title: Magic
movies.tagline: A terrifying love story.

movies.overview: Artemis Fowl is a 12-year-old genius and descendant of a long line of criminal masterminds. He soon finds himself in an epic battle against a race of powerful underground fairies who may be behind his father's disappearance.
movies.title: Artemis Fowl
movies.tagline: Remember the name

movies.overview: Jang-ho who dreams of becoming a chef is pretty close to his dad Yeong-soo; enough to talk about his girlfriend and they live alone. One day, Yeong-soo tells Jang-ho that he's getting remarried to a Russian woman. Jang-ho accepts this and meets Olga. He is surprised to see a young and beautiful woman standing before him. A few days later, Yeong-soo goes to Russia on a business trip and Jang-ho and Olga get to know each other.
movies.title: Russian Mom

movies.overview: Beverly is the perfect happy homemaker, along with her doting husband and two children, but this nuclear family just might explode when her fascination with serial killers collides with her ever-so-proper code of ethics.
movies.title: Serial Mom
movies.tagline: Every mom wants to be wanted, but not for murder!

movies.overview: Irreverent city engineer Behzad comes to a rural Kurdish village in Iran to keep vigil for a dying relative. In the meanwhile the film follows his efforts to fit in with the local community and how he changes his own attitudes as a result.
movies.title: The Wind Will Carry Us

movies.overview: Military cadets take extreme measures to ensure the future of their academy when its existence is threatened by local condo developers.
movies.title: Taps
movies.tagline: “This school is our home, we think it's worth defending.”

movies.overview: Rogue Trader tells the true story of Nick Leeson, an employee of Barings Bank who--after a successful trading run--ends up accumulating $1.4 billion in losses hidden in account #88888.
movies.title: Rogue Trader
movies.tagline: He'll risk everything to beat the system.

movies.overview: A music biopic chronicling the incredible journey of the legendary rock group the Scorpion.
movies.title: Wind of Change

movies.overview: Attempting to recover from a recent family trauma by escaping into the woods for a peaceful hiking trip, an ex-lawman and his young son stumble across a dangerous contract killer.
movies.title: The Contract
movies.tagline: Every killer meets his equal.

movies.overview: Alvin York a hillbilly sharpshooter transforms himself from ruffian to religious pacifist. He is then called to serve his country and despite deep religious and moral objections to fighting becomes one of the most celebrated American heroes of WWI.
movies.title: Sergeant York
movies.tagline: Missiles! Jets! Tanks! ... It's still the guy with guts and a gun who wins the war!

movies.overview: Karthick and Anu fall in love, get married and buy an old flat for their own. Many strange incidents happening in that house. They found out the reason and hand over the flat to the first owner Ramesh.
movies.title: House Mates

movies.original_title: シン・エヴァンゲリオン劇場版:||
movies.overview: In the aftermath of the Fourth Impact, stranded without their Evangelions, Shinji, Asuka and Rei find refuge in one of the rare pockets of humanity that still exist on the ruined planet Earth. There, each lives a life far different from their days as an Evangelion pilot. However, the danger to the world is far from over. A new impact is looming on the horizon—one that will prove to be the true end of Evangelion.
movies.title: Evangelion: 3.0+1.0 Thrice Upon a Time
movies.tagline: Bye-bye, all of EVANGELION.

movies.overview: A sketch artist and a cop work together to unravel the identity of an elusive killer using the descriptions of his face, etched into the memory of an eye-witness to the brutal crime
movies.title: Identity

movies.overview: Captain Horatio Hornblower leads his ship HMS Lydia on a perilous transatlantic voyage, during which his faithful crew battle both a Spanish warship and a ragged band of Central American rebels.
movies.title: Captain Horatio Hornblower R.N.
movies.tagline: The sun never sets on his world of adventure.

movies.overview: When a mole in an intelligence unit leads to the murder of an undercover spy, a hardened agent relentlessly pursues him to avenge the death.
movies.title: Khufiya

movies.overview: Two decades after surviving a massacre on October 31, 1978, former baby sitter Laurie Strode finds herself hunted by persistent knife-wielder Michael Myers. Laurie now lives in Northern California under an assumed name, where she works as the headmistress of a private school. But it's not far enough to escape Myers, who soon discovers her whereabouts. As Halloween descends upon Laurie's peaceful community, a feeling of dread weighs upon her -- with good reason.
movies.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
movies.tagline: This summer, terror won't be taking a vacation.

movies.original_title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
movies.overview: Janey is new in town. She soon meets Lynne, a classmate who shares her passion for the local show 'Dance TV'. When a competition is announced to find new Dance TV performers, Janey and Lynne are determined to audition. The only problem is that Janey's father doesn't approve of that kind of thing.
movies.title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
movies.tagline: Getting into trouble is easy but getting out of it is all the fun!

movies.overview: A once-respected surgeon who's lost his family and his memory gets a chance at redemption when he reconnects with someone from his forgotten past.
movies.title: Forgotten Love

movies.overview: When a professor develops a vaccine that eliminates human allergies to dogs, he unwittingly upsets the fragile balance of power between cats and dogs and touches off an epic battle for pet supremacy. The fur flies as the feline faction, led by Mr. Tinkles, squares off against wide-eyed puppy Lou and his canine cohorts.
movies.title: Cats & Dogs
movies.tagline: Things Are Gonna Get Hairy!

movies.overview: After 37 years, the canals of Amsterdam are once again turning blood red. Tara Lee is a young ambitious detective with the Amsterdam police force who is confronted by a number of gruesome incidents around the canals. She enlists the help of  Visser, a retired detective who once nabbed a serial killer stalking those same canals. They face an adversary who seems to possess superhuman powers.
movies.title: Amsterdamned II
movies.tagline: THE SAME CANALS. NEW BLOOD.

movies.overview: Karl Marx, a middle-class man in his mid-forties, lives in a small housing board quarters with his mouthy wife and his two kids. As long as he can remember Karl Marx had only one dream, to buy a couple of acres of land in his native village and do farming. This middle-class man with his middle-class dream gets a reversal of fortune because of a good deed done by his father in the past. That being a cheque for an amount of one crore rupees. But fate plays a cruel trick on Karl Marx as he misplaces the cheque and struggles to find it. He has only two days to find the missing cheque and encash it. Does he find it? Does he fulfil his dream? The story that unfolds is Middle Class
movies.title: Middle Class

movies.overview: A group of 30-year-olds who have been friends since high school attempt to throw an end-of-summer orgy.
movies.title: A Good Old Fashioned Orgy
movies.tagline: A comedy about old friends in new positions.

movies.overview: ​When a 20-something finds a cache of hidden files on his new laptop, he and his friends are unwittingly thrust into the depths of the dark web. They soon discover someone has been watching their every move and will go to unimaginable lengths to protect the dark web.
movies.title: Unfriended: Dark Web
movies.tagline: Death wants some face time.

movies.overview: A journalist takes on an underworld of crime and changes television forever.
movies.title: Primetime

movies.overview: Rita, who finds herself alone when husband Ariel works abroad. They both find solace and sexual satisfaction in other people. When Ariel comes back, they both act like nothing happened. But will this keep their marriage from falling apart?
movies.title: Rita

movies.overview: 38-year-old Alice has everything to become the next editor-in-chief of Rebelle magazine except for her uptight image. But when the young and charming Balthazar, barely 20, crosses Alice's path, she realizes that he holds the key to her promotion.
movies.title: It Boy

movies.overview: Matt Walsh's controversial doc challenges radical gender ideology through provocative interviews and humor.
movies.title: What Is a Woman?
movies.tagline: One man's journey to answer the question of a generation.

movies.overview: The career and personal life of writer Lee are at a standstill, so he divorces his bashful wife, Robin, and dives into a new job as an entertainment journalist. His assignments take him to the swankiest corners of Manhattan, but as he jumps from one lavish party to another and engages in numerous empty romances, he starts to doubt the worth of his work. Meanwhile, top TV producer Tony falls for Robin and introduces her to the world of celebrity.
movies.title: Celebrity
movies.tagline: A funny look at people who will do anything to get famous... or stay famous.

movies.overview: The eighth installment in the Paranormal Activity franchise. Plot TBA.
movies.title: Paranormal Activity 8

movies.overview: We do not know when and how we will die. Death Row inmates do. Werner Herzog embarks on a dialogue with Death Row inmates, asks questions about life and death and looks deep into these individuals, their stories, their crimes.
movies.title: Into the Abyss
movies.tagline: A gaze into the abyss of the human soul.

movies.overview: Rose Loomis and her older, gloomier husband, George, are vacationing at a cabin in Niagara Falls, N.Y. The couple befriend Polly and Ray Cutler, who are honeymooning in the area. Polly begins to suspect that something is amiss between Rose and George, and her suspicions grow when she sees Rose in the arms of another man. While Ray initially thinks Polly is overreacting, things between George and Rose soon take a shockingly dark turn.
movies.title: Niagara
movies.tagline: A raging torrent of emotion that even nature can't control!

movies.overview: After losing his wife and his memory in a car accident, a single father undergoes an experimental treatment that causes him to question who he really is.
movies.title: Black Box
movies.tagline: There is no escape from who you really are.

movies.overview: In the 1960s, a group of friends at an all girls school learn that their school is going to be combined with a nearby all boys school. They concoct a plan to save their school while dealing with everyday problems along the way.
movies.title: Strike!
movies.tagline: Get ready for a radical education.

movies.overview: After being molested, Minal and her friends try to file an FIR against a politician's nephew. When the subsequent case gets rigged, a retired lawyer helps them to fight the case.
movies.title: Pink

movies.overview: A new animated take on the classic family.
movies.title: Meet the Flintstones

movies.overview: Emma and Jesse are living the perfect life together, until Jesse disappears in a tragic helicopter crash on their first wedding anniversary. Four years later, Emma has found happiness again and is about to marry her best friend when Jesse resurfaces, turning her world upside down and leaving her torn between two great loves.
movies.title: One True Loves
movies.tagline: First love meets new love.

movies.overview: After striking gold in Alaska, the romantic George sends his womanizing partner Sam to bring his fiancée up from Seattle. When Sam finds that she has already married, he returns instead with Angel, a dancer originally from France.
movies.title: North to Alaska
movies.tagline: These were the adventures . . . fighting, laughing and brawling their way from Seattle to Nome!

movies.overview: C.S. Lewis, a world-renowned writer and professor, leads a passionless life until he meets spirited poet Joy Gresham.
movies.title: Shadowlands
movies.tagline: He distanced himself from love as he distanced himself from pain, until one woman got close enough to open his heart to the world.

movies.original_title: How to Blow Up a Pipeline
movies.overview: A crew of young environmental activists execute a daring mission to sabotage an oil pipeline.
movies.title: How to Blow Up a Pipeline
movies.tagline: This is an act of self defense.

movies.overview: When The Man in the Yellow Hat befriends Curious George in the jungle, they set off on a non-stop, fun-filled journey through the wonders of the big city toward the warmth of true friendship.
movies.title: Curious George
movies.tagline: Show me the Monkey!

movies.overview: Vuk, a 30-year-old ex-convict haunted by his best friend's suicide, is trying to save his younger brother, Zizi.
movies.title: Indigo Crystal

movies.overview: When an old card game comes to life, a family jumps back in time to a medieval village where they must unmask werewolves to secure their return home.
movies.title: Family Pack
movies.tagline: Night falls, the town is asleep.

movies.overview: Glimpses of Chaucer penning his famous work are sprinkled through this re-enactment of several of his stories.
movies.title: The Canterbury Tales
movies.tagline: From the team that gave you "Decameron", Geoffrey Chaucer's Lustiest Tales of Merrie Olde England!

movies.overview: After getting into trouble, a mischievous young man is sent to train under a brutal, but slovenly old beggar, who teaches him the secret of the Drunken Fist.
movies.title: Drunken Master
movies.tagline: The Original Kung Fu Comedy!

movies.overview: Gallic heroes and forever friends Asterix and Obelix journey to China to help Princess Sa See save the Empress and her land from a nefarious prince.
movies.title: Asterix & Obelix: The Middle Kingdom

movies.overview: When the Solomons trade in the craziness of big-city life for the quiet of a North Dakota farm, little do they expect the nightmare that follows. Soon after arriving, teenage Jess (Kristen Stewart) and her younger brother see terrifying apparitions and endure attacks from a supernatural source. Jess must warn her disbelieving family before it is too late to save them.
movies.title: The Messengers
movies.tagline: There is evidence to suggest that children are highly susceptible to paranormal phenomena. They see what adults cannot. They believe what adults deny. And they are trying to warn us.

movies.overview: Ambitious television reporter Tim O'Hara stumbles upon a martian whose spaceship has accidentally crashed on Earth. Thinking this is his ticket to a Pulitzer Prize, Tim makes plans to expose the martian, who, posing as Tim's Uncle Martin, takes human form and has plans of his own. In fact, all of Tim's efforts to divulge the truth are systematically thwarted by the resourceful alien, who ultimately recruits Tim to help him repair his ship for a return to Mars.
movies.title: My Favorite Martian
movies.tagline: The martian has landed. There goes the neighborhood.

movies.original_title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: The Long Haul
movies.overview: A Heffley family road trip to attend Meemaw's 90th birthday party goes hilariously off course thanks to Greg's newest scheme to get to a video gaming convention.
movies.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: The Long Haul
movies.tagline: Hitting the road in a whole new direction.

belongs_to_collection.name: Diary of a Wimpy Kid Collection

movies.overview: Gunman Flame and his partner Citron assassinate Nazi collaborators for the Danish resistance. Assigned targets by their Allies-connected leader, Aksel Winther, they relish the opportunity to begin targeting the Nazis themselves. When they begin to doubt the validity of their assignments, their morally complicated task becomes even more labyrinthine.
movies.title: Flame & Citron
movies.tagline: Heroes will rise, Enemies will fall

movies.overview: The third installment in the Den of Thieves franchise. Plot TBA.
movies.title: Den of Thieves 3

movies.overview: Video store clerk Ed agrees to have his life filmed by a camera crew for a tv network.
movies.title: EDtv
movies.tagline: The story of a nobody everybody is watching.

movies.overview: Kate Stone is career-focused with a brash attitude that keeps relationships at an arm's length. When her estranged brother calls asking her to baby-sit her tween niece Maddie, Kate reluctantly agrees to help. But baby-sitting overnight unexpectedly turns into a week, and Kate's life spins into chaos. As Maddie reveals stories of being bullied and of wanting to run away and be a Juggalo, the two form a unique bond.
movies.title: Family

movies.overview: A somewhat daffy book editor on a rail trip from Los Angeles to Chicago thinks that he sees a murdered man thrown from the train. When he can find no one who will believe him, he starts doing some investigating of his own. But all that accomplishes is to get the killer after him.
movies.title: Silver Streak
movies.tagline: By train, by plane, by the edge of your seat - It's the most hilarious suspense ride of your life!

movies.overview: 7 years after the case related to Vijay Salgaonkar and his family was closed, a series of unexpected events bring truth to light that threatens to change everything for the Salgaonkars. Can Vijay save his family this time?
movies.title: Drishyam 2

movies.overview: Alex, a boy obsessed with scary stories, is trapped by a witch in her modern, magical New York City apartment. His original hair-raising tales are the only thing keeping him safe as he desperately tries to find a way out of this twisted place.
movies.title: Nightbooks
movies.tagline: Write for your life.

movies.overview: When Environmental Protection Agency inspector Steve Malone travels to a remote military base in order to check for toxic materials, he brings his family along for the ride. After arriving at the base, his teenage daughter Marti befriends Jean Platt, daughter of the base's commander, General Platt. When people at the base begin acting strangely, Marti becomes convinced that they are slowly being replaced by plant-like aliens.
movies.title: Body Snatchers
movies.tagline: Imagine... you're gone and someone else is living inside your body.

movies.overview: A gang of young thieves flee Paris during the violent aftermath of a political election, only to hole up at an Inn run by neo-Nazis.
movies.title: Frontier(s)
movies.tagline: What are your boundaries...

movies.overview: Young mother Alejandra is a working housewife, raising two boys with husband Angel in a small city. Her brother Fabian works as a nurse in a local hospital. Their provincial lives are upset with the arrival of mysterious Veronica. Sex and love can be fragile in certain regions where strong family values, hypocrisy, homophobia, and male chauvinism exist. Veronica convinces them that in the nearby woods, inside an isolated cabin, dwells something not of this world that could be the answer to all of their problems. Something whose force they cannot resist and with whom they must make peace or suffer its wrath.
movies.title: The Untamed
movies.tagline: When desire surpasses fear.

movies.overview: Commissioned to map the Far East territories of the Russian Empire, cartographer Jonathan Green sets off on a long journey of unbelievable adventures—making breath-taking discoveries and meeting mysterious creatures, Chinese princesses, deadly masters of oriental martial arts, and even the King of Dragons.
movies.title: Iron Mask

movies.overview: On a weekend backpacking trip in the Catskills, 17-year-old Sam contends with the competing egos of her father and his oldest friend.
movies.title: Good One

movies.overview: A Chinese-American lesbian and her traditionalist mother are reluctant to go public with secret loves that clash against cultural expectations.
movies.title: Saving Face
movies.tagline: A romantic comedy about right, wrong and everything in between.

movies.overview: In a world hit by a wave of mutations transforming humans into animals, François does everything he can to save his wife. As some of the creatures disappear into a nearby forest, he and their son Émile embark on a quest that will change their lives forever.
movies.title: The Animal Kingdom
movies.tagline: All creatures crave freedom.

movies.overview: A coming-of-age story centered around a small-town singer brokenhearted by the death of her brother in a car crash, who had secretly submitted her for a summer session at a performing arts academy in Los Angeles. In the academy, she experiences a whole new way of life in the big city, far from the small town lifestyle she's used to.
movies.title: Raise Your Voice
movies.tagline: Don't Hold Back ...Don't Give Up.

movies.overview: An egotistical saxophone player and a young singer meet on V-J Day and embark upon a strained and rocky romance, even as their careers begin a long uphill climb.
movies.title: New York, New York
movies.tagline: The war was over and the world was falling in love again.

movies.original_title: To All the Boys: P.S. I Still Love You
movies.overview: Lara Jean and Peter have just taken their romance from pretend to officially real when another recipient of one of her love letters enters the picture.
movies.title: To All the Boys: P.S. I Still Love You
movies.tagline: Follow your heart like never before

movies.original_title: Put your soul on your hand and walk
movies.overview: An Iranian filmmaker participates in a series of video calls with a young Palestinian photojournalist who describes her life confined in Gaza during the current regional conflict.
movies.title: Put Your Soul on Your Hand and Walk

movies.overview: Lifestyle guru Joy Edwards - whose cookbooks feature her perfect home life and family - is horrified when a TV network decides to film Christmas dinner at her fabled, but fabricated, country home. Now, she must recruit her best friend Max to pose as her fake husband for the cameras - but they both discover something real along the way.
movies.title: Joy to the World
movies.tagline: She created the perfect life. Now she has to create the perfect family.

movies.overview: After hiding his loot and getting thrown in jail, brooding outlaw Ruby befriends Quentin, a dim-witted and garrulous giant. After Quentin botches a solo escape attempt, they make a break together. Unable to shake the clumsy Quentin, Ruby is forced to take him along as he pursues his former partners in crime to avenge the death of the woman he loved and get to the money.
movies.title: Ruby & Quentin

movies.overview: Brilliant student Jeff Chang has the most important interview of his life tomorrow.  But today is still his birthday, what starts off as a casual celebration with friends evolves into a night of debauchery that risks to derail his life plan.
movies.title: 21 & Over
movies.tagline: Finally.

movies.overview: New York, 1929, a war rages between two rival gangsters, Fat Sam and Dandy Dan. Dan is in possession of a new and deadly weapon, the dreaded "splurge gun". As the custard pies fly, Bugsy Malone, an all-round nice guy, falls for Blousey Brown, a singer at Fat Sam's speakeasy. His designs on her are disrupted by the seductive songstress Tallulah who wants Bugsy for herself.
movies.title: Bugsy Malone
movies.tagline: Every year brings a great movie. Every decade a great movie musical!

movies.overview: A taxi driver finds himself embroiled in a dangerous conspiracy after his car is confiscated by a corrupt police officer.
movies.title: Thudarum

movies.overview: After Shideh's building is hit by a missile during the Iran-Iraq War, a superstitious neighbor suggests that the missile was cursed and might be carrying malevolent Middle-Eastern spirits. She becomes convinced a supernatural force within the building is attempting to possess her daughter Dorsa, and she has no choice but to confront these forces if she is to save her daughter and herself.
movies.title: Under the Shadow
movies.tagline: Fear will find you.

movies.overview: After a viral outbreak ravaged the country’s adult population, a group of orphans heads south in search of a new life, only to find themselves at the mercy of a deranged woman harboring a dangerous secret.
movies.title: Please Don't Feed the Children
movies.tagline: Don't run. Don't scream. Don't break the rules

movies.original_title: ウマ娘 プリティーダービー 新時代の扉
movies.overview: Jungle Pocket, an Umamusume who has been racing tirelessly in pursuit of becoming the greatest, is ready to take on the once-in-a-lifetime Classic Triple Crown series. However, standing in her way are rivals from the same generation, whose talent may even surpass her own.
movies.title: Umamusume: Pretty Derby - Beginning of a New Era

movies.overview: Biography of Loretta Lynn, a country and western singer that came from poverty to fame.
movies.title: Coal Miner's Daughter
movies.tagline: She became a singer because it was the only thing she could do. She became a star because it was the only way she could do it.

movies.overview: After she betrays a powerful mob boss, a woman matches wits and weaponry with a legion of killers who are out to collect the bounty on the heads of her and her family.
movies.title: Everly
movies.tagline: Enter if you dare.

movies.overview: Guilherme and Sofia, brother and sister, grow up sharing experiences and slowly discovering their sexuality. The thing that Sofia doesn't know is how far Guilherme will go to keep her inside his own perverse, dark and perfect circle.
movies.title: How to Draw a Perfect Circle

movies.overview: An operative for an elite private intelligence firm finds her priorities irrevocably changed after she is tasked with infiltrating an anarchist group known for executing covert attacks upon major corporations.
movies.title: The East
movies.tagline: Spy on us, we'll spy on you.

movies.overview: A man and woman navigate the highs and lows of a long-distance relationship.
movies.title: Mindiyum Paranjum

movies.overview: A woman's carefully constructed life is upended when an unwelcome shadow from her past returns, forcing her to confront the monster she's evaded for two decades.
movies.title: Resurrection
movies.tagline: Maintain control.

movies.overview: Robert Talbot, an American millionaire, arrives early for his annual vacation at his luxurious Italian villa. His long-time girlfriend Lisa has given up waiting for him and has decided to marry another man. Meanwhile, his sneaky business associate Maurice secretly misappropriates the villa as a hotel while Talbot is away. The current guests of the "hotel" are a group of young American girls.
movies.title: Come September
movies.tagline: A Quiet hideaway... A Secret rendezvous... then the teen-agers barged in!

movies.overview: When 9-year-old orphan Oliver Twist dares to ask his cruel taskmaster, Mr. Bumble, for a second serving of gruel, he's hired out as an apprentice. Escaping that dismal fate, young Oliver falls in with the street urchin known as the Artful Dodger and his criminal mentor, Fagin. When kindly Mr. Brownlow takes Oliver in, Fagin's evil henchman Bill Sikes plots to kidnap the boy.
movies.title: Oliver Twist
movies.tagline: ADAPTED FROM CHARLES DICKENS' CRITICALLY ACCLAIMED NOVEL!- HASHIR

movies.overview: Jimmy Erskine is the most feared theatre critic of the age. He lives as flamboyantly as he writes and takes pleasure in savagely taking down any actor who fails to meet his standards. When the owner of the Daily Chronicle dies, and his son takes over, Jimmy quickly finds himself at odds with his new boss and his position under threat. In an attempt to preserve the power and influence he holds so sacred, Jimmy strikes a Faustian pact with a struggling actress, entangling them and the boss in a thrilling but deadly web of desire, blackmail, and betrayal.
movies.title: The Critic
movies.tagline: Ambition seduces. Power corrupts.

movies.overview: Franklin Shepard is a talented Broadway composer who abandons his theater career and all his friends in New York in order to produce films in Los Angeles. The story begins at the height of his Hollywood fame and moves backwards in time, showing snapshots of the most important moments in Frank’s life that shaped the man he is today.
movies.title: Merrily We Roll Along

movies.overview: Centered around a television station which features a 1950s-style sci-fi movie interspersed with a series of wild commercials, wacky shorts and weird specials, this lampoon of contemporary life and pop culture skewers some of the silliest spectacles ever created in the name of entertainment.
movies.title: Amazon Women on the Moon
movies.tagline: See amazing thrills, spine-tingling chills, and something else that rhymes with "thrills".

movies.overview: An original story set in "Evil Dead" universe. Premise TBA.
movies.title: Evil Dead Wrath

movies.overview: When one of them breaks a leg, five friends snowboarding in the Norwegian mountains take shelter in an abandoned ski lodge and soon realize they’re not alone.
movies.title: Cold Prey
movies.tagline: You'll Catch Your Death.

movies.overview: Chronicles a recovering addict's journey through drug underworld, struggles with addiction, intense highs, and lows, and eventual path to sobriety.
movies.title: The Prince

movies.overview: The year is 1893 and India is under British occupation. In a small village, the tyrannical Captain Russell has imposed an unprecedented land tax on its citizens. Outraged, Bhuvan, a rebellious farmer, rallies the villagers to publicly oppose the tax. Russell offers a novel way to settle the dispute: he challenges Bhuvan and his men to a game of cricket, a sport completely foreign to India. If Bhuvan and his men can defeat Russell's team, the tax will be repealed.
movies.title: Lagaan: Once Upon a Time in India
movies.tagline: Once upon a time in India

movies.overview: In czarist Russia, a neurotic soldier and his distant cousin formulate a plot to assassinate Napoleon.
movies.title: Love and Death
movies.tagline: The Comedy Sensation of the Year!

movies.overview: Exhibit A tells the timely story of a normal family disintegrating under financial pressure. All is not as it seems as the King family go about their day-to-day lives oblivious of the horror to come. Dad Andy (Bradley Cole) is nursing a secret that ultimately leads to terrible consequences for them all. We witness these chilling events unfold through daughter Judith's video camera, which subsequently becomes Exhibit A.
movies.title: Exhibit A
movies.tagline: The camera never lies...

movies.overview: A young woman inherits an old hotel in Louisiana where, following a series of supernatural "accidents", she learns that the building was built over one of the entrances to Hell.
movies.title: The Beyond
movies.tagline: Beyond death... Beyond Evil... Beyond the dreaded gates of hell.

movies.overview: For the past four years, San Francisco cop Jack Cates has been after an unidentified drug kingpin who calls himself the Ice Man. Jack finds a picture that proves that the Ice Man has put a price on the head of Reggie Hammond, who is scheduled to be released from prison on the next day.
movies.title: Another 48 Hrs.
movies.tagline: The boys are back in town.

movies.overview: A struggling female soprano finds work playing a male female impersonator, but it complicates her personal life.
movies.title: Victor/Victoria
movies.tagline: The disguise surprise comedy of the year!

movies.original_title: The Man Who Killed Hitler and Then the Bigfoot
movies.overview: Decades after serving in WWII and assassinating Adolf Hitler, a legendary American war veteran must now hunt down the fabled Bigfoot.
movies.title: The Man Who Killed Hitler and Then the Bigfoot
movies.tagline: An American Myth

movies.overview: During a stormy night in the Scottish Highlands, two criminal brothers on the run seek refuge in a desolate farmhouse. But after taking the resident family captive, they find the house holds even darker secrets of its own.
movies.title: Little Bone Lodge
movies.tagline: A mother always protects her family.

movies.overview: Likeable 6th grader Liam writes to Santa asking him to prove that he's real. But Liam is dyslexic and accidentally sends his letter to Satan instead, who shows up at Liam's house, excited to have his first fanboy letter and wanting a little of Liam's soul.
movies.title: Dear Santa
movies.tagline: Jack Black is NOT Santa.

movies.overview: A day in the life of a barbershop on the south side of Chicago. Calvin, who inherited the struggling business from his deceased father, views the shop as nothing but a burden and waste of his time. After selling the shop to a local loan shark, Calvin slowly begins to see his father's vision and legacy and struggles with the notion that he just sold it out.
movies.title: Barbershop
movies.tagline: Everyone's gettin' lined up.

movies.overview: It was an ingenious enough plan: rob the Riviera Casino's count room during an Elvis impersonator convention. But Thomas Murphy decided to keep all the money for himself and shot all his partners, including recently-freed ex-con Michael Zane. With $3.2 million at stake, the Marshals Service closing in, Michael must track down Murphy.
movies.title: 3000 Miles to Graceland
movies.tagline: Crime Is King

movies.overview: A Beverly Hills housewife in the middle of a divorce tries to find focus in her life by taking over her daughter's Wilderness Girls troop.
movies.title: Troop Beverly Hills
movies.tagline: When the going gets tough, the tough go shopping!

movies.overview: A wife, overwhelmed with hatred for her husband, inflicts an unspeakable wound on their son, as the family heads towards horrific destruction.
movies.title: Moebius
movies.tagline: Hell hath no fury like a woman scorned.

movies.overview: A young interracial couple has just moved into their California dream home when they become the target of their next-door neighbor, who disapproves of their relationship. A tightly wound LAPD officer has appointed himself the watchdog of the neighborhood. His nightly foot patrols and overly watchful eyes bring comfort to some, but he becomes increasingly aggressive to the newlyweds. These persistent intrusions into their lives cause the couple to fight back.
movies.title: Lakeview Terrace
movies.tagline: What Could Be Safer Than Living Next to a Cop?

movies.overview: Explores Leni Riefenstahl's artistic legacy and her complex ties to the Nazi regime, juxtaposing her self-portrayal with evidence suggesting awareness of the regime's atrocities.
movies.title: Riefenstahl

movies.overview: Hubert is a French policeman with very sharp methods. After being forced to take 2 months off by his boss, who doesn't share his view on working methods, he goes back to Japan, where he used to work 19 years ago, to settle the probate of his girlfriend who left him shortly after marriage without a trace.
movies.title: Wasabi
movies.tagline: For those who take their action raw.

movies.overview: A group of juvenile delinquents live a violent life in the infamous slums of Mexico City; among them Pedro, whose morality is gradually corrupted and destroyed by the others.
movies.title: The Young and the Damned

movies.overview: In New York City for their annual tradition of Christmas Eve debauchery, three lifelong best friends set out to find the Holy Grail of Christmas parties since their yearly reunion might be coming to an end.
movies.title: The Night Before
movies.tagline: Their past, present and future. All in one night.

movies.overview: Three stories about the world of opioids collide: a drug trafficker arranges a multi-cartel Fentanyl smuggling operation between Canada and the U.S., an architect recovering from an OxyContin addiction tracks down the truth behind her son's involvement with narcotics, and a university professor battles unexpected revelations about his research employer, a drug company with deep government influence bringing a new "non-addictive" painkiller to market.
movies.title: Crisis
movies.tagline: Addiction is an industry.

movies.overview: The true story of Sam Childers, a former drug-dealing biker who finds God and became a crusader for hundreds of Sudanese children who've been kidnapped and pressed into duty as soldiers.
movies.title: Machine Gun Preacher
movies.tagline: Hope is the greatest weapon of all

movies.overview: With dreams of diving abroad, Tsuneo gets a job assisting Josee, an artist whose imagination takes her far beyond her wheelchair. But when the tide turns against them, they push each other to places they never thought possible, and inspire a love fit for a storybook.
movies.title: Josee, the Tiger and the Fish
movies.tagline: Together they can fly.

movies.overview: Paris, 1910. Emile, a shy movie projectionist, and Raoul, a colourful inventor, find themselves embarked on the hunt for a monster terrorizing citizens. They join forces with Lucille, the big-hearted star of the Bird of Paradise cabaret, an eccentric scientist and his irascible monkey to save the monster, who turns out to be an oversized but harmless flea, from the city's ruthlessly ambitious police chief.
movies.title: A Monster in Paris
movies.tagline: You can find love anywhere… even in insects

movies.overview: Ronnie runs a Disco walking tour with his son, Brayden. When a sexy woman takes the tour, it begins a competition between father and son for her love. It also signals the arrival of an oily strangler who stalks the streets at night.
movies.title: The Greasy Strangler
movies.tagline: BULLSHIT ARTIST!

movies.overview: Befriended by aristocrat Sebastian Flyte, Oxford student Charles Ryder finds that the power and privilege experienced by the family is seductive. On a visit to the ancestral home, Brideshead, he falls in love with his friend's sister, Julia.  However, as his ties to the Flytes deepen, Ryder finds himself at odds with their strong Roman Catholicism.
movies.title: Brideshead Revisited
movies.tagline: Privilege. Ambition. Desire. At Brideshead everything comes at a price.

movies.overview: Two penniless orphans, Black and White, struggle to survive on the mean streets of Treasure Town. When a megacorporation threatens to tear down the town to build an amusement park, Black and White engage in the fight of their life.
movies.title: Tekkonkinkreet
movies.tagline: The power of brotherhood, betrayal, loyalty, and humanity

movies.overview: Ryota Nonomiya is a successful businessman driven by money. He learns that his biological son was switched with another child after birth. He must make a life-changing decision and choose his true son or the boy he raised as his own.
movies.title: Like Father, Like Son
movies.tagline: At what point does a father truly become a father?

movies.overview: A determined lawyer takes on a high-stakes case to defend a 19-year-old boy, challenging a system that has already branded him guilty.
movies.title: Court: State vs. A Nobody

movies.overview: A beautiful and mysterious woman helps an inept scam artist get his game together... but is their meeting purely coincidence?
movies.title: Angel-A

movies.overview: An alien consciousness, sent to Earth to spy on one of its own kind, learns what it means to be human.
movies.title: The Infinite Husk
movies.tagline: Find home - in this body or the next.

movies.overview: When reporter Rachel Armstrong writes a story that reveals the identity of a covert CIA operative, the government demands that Rachel reveal her source. She defies the special prosecutor and is thrown in jail. Meanwhile, her attorney, Albert Burnside argues her case all the way to the U.S. Supreme Court.
movies.title: Nothing But the Truth
movies.tagline: Don't Reveal the Source.

movies.overview: Following Jigsaw's grisly demise, Detective Mark Hoffman is commended as a hero, but Agent Strahm is suspicious, and delves into Hoffman's past. Meanwhile, another group of people are put through a series of gruesome tests.
movies.title: Saw V
movies.tagline: You won't believe how it ends.

movies.overview: A stone-broke gay actor and a privileged screw-up with a failing business cross paths on a winter night and join forces in a quest around London to find a meaning to their miserable lives, but when their unlikely connection turns into something deeper, fears and demons from their past come to jeopardise the whole mission.
movies.title: A Night Like This
movies.tagline: Two strangers. One night. A quest for redemption.

movies.overview: Led by Kim Philby, Plan Aurora is a plan that breaches the top-secret Fourth Protocol and turns the fears that shaped it into a living nightmare. A crack Soviet agent, placed under cover in a quiet English country town, begins to assemble a nuclear bomb, whilst an MI5 agent attempts to prevent its detonation.
movies.title: The Fourth Protocol
movies.tagline: If the Fourth Protocol is ever breached, there would be no warning, just a nuclear explosion from a bedsitter... The unthinkable has just begun.

movies.overview: The life of the bullfighter Andrés Roca Rey during a day of bullfighting, from the moment he dresses up to the moment he undresses.
movies.title: Afternoons of Solitude

movies.overview: Two French policemen, one investigating a grisly murder at a remote mountain college, the other working on the desecration of a young girl's grave by skinheads, are brought together by the clues from their respective cases. Soon after they start working together, more murders are committed, and the pair begin to discover just what dark secrets are behind the killings.
movies.title: The Crimson Rivers
movies.tagline: Evil rises to new heights.

movies.overview: Joey Boca is the owner of a pizza parlour, and has been married to Rosalie for years. When Rosalie discovers that Joey is a womanizer and has been cheating on her for a long time, she goes to extreme lengths to punish him.
movies.title: I Love You to Death
movies.tagline: With these people trying to kill him, Joey Boca may just live forever.

movies.overview: The fate of a Hungarian Jewish family throughout the 20th century.
movies.title: Sunshine
movies.tagline: In a time of revolution, in a family torn by tradition, one man was consumed by love.

movies.overview: In the panicky, uncertain hours before his wedding, a groom with prenuptial jitters and his two best friends reminisce about growing up together in the middle-class African-American neighborhood of Inglewood, California. Flashing back to the twenty-something trio's childhood exploits, the memories capture the mood and nostalgia of the '80s era.
movies.title: The Wood
movies.tagline: From boyhood to manhood, you can always count on your best friends.

movies.overview: At a prestigious all-male university, three friends seek love outside of the school grounds; at the same time, a newly-hired music teacher seeks to befriend and loosen up the militantly strict headmaster.
movies.title: Mohabbatein
movies.tagline: Some Love Stories... Live Forever

movies.original_title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors
movies.overview: A psychiatrist, familiar with the knife-wielding dream demon Freddy Krueger, helps teens at a mental hospital battle the killer who is invading their dreams.
movies.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors
movies.tagline: If you think you'll get out alive, you must be dreaming.

belongs_to_collection.name: A Nightmare on Elm Street Collection

movies.overview: Bombs tear through Bombay in 1993, wreaking havoc and polarising the citizens. With perpetrators at large, the state launches a massive man-hunt to unmask the perpetrators behind these events.
movies.title: Black Friday
movies.tagline: The shocking truth behind the '93 Bombay blasts

movies.overview: Former Special Forces operative, Jack Johnson, uses the Stand Your Ground law to seek vengeance for his wife’s murder, igniting a brutal war against a local crime lord’s family and ending in an explosive showdown.
movies.title: Stand Your Ground
movies.tagline: Their town, his war.

movies.overview: A dog who strives to become a man seeks a woman who will love him enough for the transformation to take place.
movies.title: Love on a Leash
movies.tagline: Love at first bark.

movies.overview: In the early days of Nazi Germany, a powerful noble family must adjust to life under the new dictatorship regime.
movies.title: The Damned
movies.tagline: He was soon to become the second most powerful man in Nazi Germany.

movies.overview: A psychologist with a keen interest in criminology gets entangled in a tough serial killer case which the police find hard to crack.
movies.title: Anjaam Pathiraa

movies.overview: Phillip Filmore is a naive, 15-year-old, preoccupied with sex, who develops a crush on Nicole Mallow, the new 30-something, French housekeeper and sitter to look after him when Phillip's father is out of town for the summer on a "business" trip. But Mr. Filmore's unscrupulous chauffeur, Lester Lewis, takes advantage of Phillip's crush on Nicole to hire her to seduce the youth, then draws her into a plot to fake her own death in a blackmail scheme aimed to drain Phillip's trust fund.
movies.title: Private Lessons
movies.tagline: When EMANUELLE's Sylvia Kristel is your teacher the bedroom is the classroom

movies.overview: Years after her boyfriend left her for the big city and promised to bring her there after he’s settled down, a Chinese woman sets out on a journey to be reunited with him.
movies.title: Caught by the Tides
movies.tagline: A film over 20 years in the making.

movies.overview: The residents of a rural mining town discover that an unfortunate chemical spill has caused hundreds of little spiders to mutate overnight to the size of SUVs. It's then up to mining engineer Chris McCormack and Sheriff Sam Parker to mobilize an eclectic group of townspeople, including the Sheriff's young son, Mike, her daughter, Ashley, and paranoid radio announcer Harlan, into battle against the bloodthirsty eight-legged beasts.
movies.title: Eight Legged Freaks
movies.tagline: Let the squashing begin!

movies.overview: When a no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas gets a whole lot more complicated.
movies.title: Guarding Stars

movies.overview: When scientists exploring the Amazon River stumble on a “missing link” connecting humans and fish, they plan to capture it for later study. But the Creature has plans of his own, and has set his sights on the lead scientist's beautiful fiancée, Kay.
movies.title: Creature from the Black Lagoon
movies.tagline: From the Amazon's forbidden depths came the Creature from the Black Lagoon

belongs_to_collection.name: Creature from the Black Lagoon Collection

movies.overview: Maureen, mid-20s, is a personal shopper for a media celebrity. The job pays for her stay in Paris, a city she refuses to leave until she makes contact with her twin brother who previously died there. Her life becomes more complicated when a mysterious person contacts her via text message.
movies.title: Personal Shopper

movies.overview: A pious 20-year-old juvenile delinquent is sent to work at a sawmill in a small town; on arrival, he dresses up as a priest and accidentally takes over the local parish. The arrival of this young, charismatic preacher is an opportunity for the local community to begin the healing process after a tragedy that happened a year prior.
movies.title: Corpus Christi
movies.tagline: Sinner. Preacher. A Mystery.

movies.overview: After the death of her husband, a mother takes her kids off to live with their grandparents in a huge, decrepit old mansion. However, the kids are kept hidden in a room just below the attic, visited only by their mother who becomes less and less concerned about them and their failing health, and more concerned about herself and the inheritence she plans to win back from her dying father.
movies.title: Flowers in the Attic
movies.tagline: Home sweet home is murder.

movies.overview: At Pacific Palisades High, a poor Latino falls hard for a troubled girl from the affluent neighborhood.
movies.title: Crazy/Beautiful
movies.tagline: When it's real. When it's right. Don't let anything stand in your way.

movies.overview: A crew of rugged firefighters meet their match when attempting to rescue three rambunctious kids.
movies.title: Playing with Fire
movies.tagline: 0% contained.

movies.overview: Four best friends negotiate loss and major life changes during the last two weeks of high school.
movies.title: Dude
movies.tagline: Growing up. Moving on. Lighting up.

movies.overview: An octogenarian woman transitions to life in assisted living as she contends with her conflicting relationship to herself and her caregivers amidst her shifting memory, age identity, and desires.
movies.title: Familiar Touch
